jobs.description:
Job Title:

Sr. Marketing Manager, AI Data Services & Trust & Safety Practice

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Concentrix is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Marketing Manager to lead marketing for our global AI Data Services & Trust & Safety Practice.

This role will be responsible for developing and executing the Practice marketing strategy, building awareness of our capabilities, engaging priority clients and prospects, supporting Sales and Business Development, and demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline and revenue.

Reporting directly to the GVP of AI Data Services & Trust & Safety, the Marketing Manager will own the Practice marketing budget and work closely with Concentrix Corporate Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Business Development, Practice leadership and subject-matter experts.

The ideal candidate combines B2B marketing strategy, events, demand generation, content development, thought leadership, social media, account-based marketing and marketing analytics. This is a hands-on role for someone who can develop the strategy, mobilize internal resources, execute programs, and measure their commercial impact.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

Practice Marketing Strategy & Budget

  • Develop and manage the annual and quarterly marketing strategy for the AI Data Services & Trust & Safety Practice, aligned to growth priorities, target accounts and revenue objectives.

  • Translate Practice priorities into integrated marketing campaigns across events, content, social media, demand generation, targeted outreach, sponsorships and sales enablement.

  • Own the Practice marketing budget, including planning, allocation, tracking and recommendations for optimizing spend based on measurable results.

  • Evaluate potential investments across conferences, owned events, associations, lead-generation platforms, sponsored content, paid campaigns, and other marketing channels.

  • Stay current on developments across AI, AI training, data services, AI safety and Trust & Safety to identify emerging marketing opportunities and areas where Concentrix can establish a differentiated point of view.

Events, Demand Generation & Account-Based Marketing

  • Develop and execute marketing strategies for third-party conferences, Concentrix-hosted events, executive roundtables, networking events, webinars, client events and internal sector events.

  • Recommend where the Practice should attend, sponsor, speak, host meetings or create adjacent events based on audience quality and business potential.

  • Build target-account and invitation lists in partnership with Sales and Business Development for Practice-owned events and strategic conferences.

  • Develop compelling invitation campaigns through email, LinkedIn, social media and other targeted outreach to drive attendance from relevant executives and decision-makers.

  • Coordinate event messaging, branding, collateral, speakers, attendee communications, executive meetings and follow-up.

  • Build post-event engagement and nurture programs that convert attendees, registrants and priority prospects into meetings and sales opportunities.

  • Support account-based marketing programs designed to reach multiple stakeholders across priority organizations, including leaders in AI, data, product, engineering, operations, Trust & Safety and other relevant functions.

  • Partner with Concentrix Demand Generation teams to create campaigns that generate and nurture qualified demand for Practice services.

Content, Thought Leadership & Social Media

  • Develop and manage an ongoing content and thought-leadership strategy covering AI Data Services, AI model development and evaluation, AI safety, Trust & Safety and emerging market trends.

  • Write blogs, articles, executive perspectives, newsletters and other content directly, or engage Practice subject-matter experts and other contributors where appropriate.

  • Interview Practice executives and SMEs and translate complex technical or operational topics into clear, compelling market-facing content.

  • Identify opportunities for contributed articles, sponsored content, industry publications, webinars, panels, podcasts and speaking engagements.

  • Build a structured thought-leadership program for Practice leaders, including LinkedIn posts, executive commentary, presentation concepts and market POVs.

  • Own the ongoing content strategy for the Practice's LinkedIn presence, maintaining a consistent weekly and monthly publishing cadence.

  • Create a balanced mix of market insights, thought leadership, event promotion, client outcomes, capabilities, employee expertise and industry commentary.

  • Track social and content performance, including audience growth, engagement, traffic, conversions and resulting commercial opportunities.

Marketing Collateral, Case Studies & Sales Enablement

  • Lead development and maintenance of high-quality internal and external marketing collateral supporting AI Data Services and Trust & Safety.

  • Create capability overviews, one-pagers, presentations, solution briefs, use-case materials, infographics, executive POVs, event materials and other sales-enablement assets.

  • Develop targeted content for specific industries, buyer groups, client challenges and emerging AI use cases.

  • Partner with Sales and Business Development to identify gaps in the materials required to support client conversations and prospect engagement.

  • Establish and manage a pipeline of potential client case studies and proof points.

  • Work with delivery teams and account leaders to identify engagements with measurable outcomes that can be developed into client stories, testimonials or anonymized case studies.

  • Maintain an organized and current repository of Practice marketing and sales assets.

Corporate Marketing & Internal Practice Marketing

  • Serve as the primary marketing liaison between the Practice and Concentrix Corporate Marketing, Demand Generation, Communications and related teams.

  • Ensure Practice priorities are represented within broader Concentrix campaigns and marketing programs.

  • Develop internal communications and enablement materials that help Concentrix sellers and account leaders understand AI Data Services and Trust & Safety capabilities, market opportunities, proof points and available assets.

  • Support internal sector meetings, leadership events and client-attended forums where the Practice has an opportunity to build awareness or generate opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities for broader external visibility through analyst engagement, awards, industry associations, executive networks and relevant media channels.

Marketing Analytics, Pipeline Attribution & ROI

  • Own measurement and reporting for Practice marketing activity and provide clear monthly and quarterly updates to Practice leadership.

  • Establish consistent tracking for events, campaigns, content, social media, memberships, sponsored programs and other marketing investments.

  • Track metrics including target-account engagement, event registrations and attendance, meetings generated, leads, opportunities, pipeline created, pipeline influenced and closed-won revenue.

  • Measure the effectiveness and ROI of individual events, campaigns, platforms and marketing investments.

  • Work with Sales and Business Development to maintain effective lead routing, campaign attribution and follow-up.

  • Use performance data to recommend adjustments to marketing strategy, channel mix and budget allocation.

  • Ensure marketing reporting demonstrates not only activity and engagement, but marketing's contribution to Practice growth.

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you have:

  • 5+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, ideally within technology, artificial intelligence, professional services, outsourcing, digital services, SaaS or another complex enterprise-services environment.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated B2B marketing strategies.

  • Strong experience with event marketing, demand generation and targeted account engagement.

  • Experience partnering closely with enterprise Sales and Business Development teams.

  • Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex subject matter into compelling executive-level content.

  • Experience developing blogs, thought leadership, case studies, presentations, sales collateral and social-media content.

  • Strong understanding of LinkedIn and B2B social-media marketing.

  • Demonstrated experience measuring campaign performance, marketing attribution, pipeline contribution and return on investment.

  • Experience managing marketing budgets, vendors, agencies, publishers or external partners.

  • Strong project-management skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, events and deadlines.

  • Comfort working directly with senior executives and subject-matter experts.

  • Ability to operate effectively within a large global organization and influence stakeholders across multiple functions.

  • Strong intellectual curiosity and willingness to rapidly develop expertise in AI Data Services and Trust & Safety.

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing AI, machine learning, data, Trust & Safety, digital platforms or related technology services.

  • Experience marketing complex managed services or outsourcing solutions to large enterprises and technology companies.

  • Experience with account-based marketing, CRM campaign attribution and marketing automation.

  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and supporting external speaking opportunities.

  • Experience managing global marketing programs across the United States, United Kingdom and other international markets.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Marketing Manager will help the Practice:

  • Increase awareness and understanding of Concentrix AI Data Services and Trust & Safety among priority audiences.

  • Build engagement within strategic target accounts.

  • Generate qualified meetings, leads and opportunities through marketing activity.

  • Demonstrate measurable pipeline and revenue contribution from events and campaigns.

  • Improve the return generated from the Practice marketing budget.

  • Establish a consistent and credible thought-leadership presence in the market.

  • Maintain high-quality, current collateral and client proof points that support Sales and Business Development.

  • Provide clear visibility into marketing performance through disciplined monthly and quarterly reporting.

The position will require periodic travel for industry conferences, client events, executive roundtables, Concentrix meetings and other Practice marketing activities.

What’s in it for you

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

  • Full time position

  • Remote working

  • Competitive Salary

Power the best version of you!

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer

We're proudly united as one team, one company, globally. We're committed to equal employment opportunities for all candidates and a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All our recruitment practices are based on business needs, job requirements, and professional qualifications, without regard to race, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, family or parental status, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable national laws.

Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Enterprise Account Executive who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

About the Company:

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

As a Account Executive for the Northeast, you will be responsible for existing and prospect accounts in our Healthcare vertical in the Northeast. While you strategically "farm" and expand our existing footprint in existing accounts, you will also hunt and win Fortune 500 accounts by leveraging a high-activity mindset and a deep network of local channel partners. This is a high-visibility role for a closer who thrives on navigating complex cycles and positioning Claroty as the gold standard for securing mission-critical medical and clinical environments. We are open to candidates in NY/NJ/CT/MA.

Responsibilities

As a Enterprise Account Executive your impact will be:

  • Demonstrate extensive experience collaborating with Fortune 500 and global customers, particularly within the Healthcare industry.
  • Execute comprehensive land-and-expand campaigns, managing projects from proof of concept (POC) to large-scale deployments.
  • Meet and exceed enterprise quota targets consistently.
  • Cultivate local partnerships with key allies such as Crowdstrike, ServiceNow, Cisco, CDW, Guidepoint, and others.
  • Generate high-quality appointments and cultivate pipeline opportunities.
  • Periodically participate in industry conferences and events.
  • Conduct presentations and demonstrations showcasing Claroty’s cutting-edge products.

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

Experience & Domain Expertise

  • Minimum of 8 years experience in enterprise cybersecurity or technology sales, with a track record of closing large, complex deals, preferably within the Cyber Security and Healthcare sector.
  • Proven history of quota overachievement ($3–5M+ ARR), with strong track record of quota achievement.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Force Management, and Challenger Sales selling methodologies.
  • Strong multitasking skills and adaptability in dynamic work environments.
  • Exhibit a positive attitude, flexibility, and maintain high ethical standards.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, along with strong presentation capabilities.
  • Willingness to travel 50% of the time

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite in The Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 multiple consecutive years.

Expected compensation for the role is between $165,000 - $175,000. This is a good faith estimate but does not include equity, bonus, or other forms of payment. Pay will be determined by experience level, but those outside the salary band are welcome to apply.

Claroty is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of ALL diverse backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases.

Conditions d'admissibilité : Ouvert uniquement aux citoyens canadiens et aux résidents permanents du Canada

À propos des affectations de volontariat virtuel

Acquérez une expérience internationale où que vous soyez grâce à Cuso International. Ces affectations de coopération volontaire virtuelle sont destinées aux personnes à la recherche d’une expérience enrichissante et axée sur les compétences dans le domaine du développement international, entièrement en ligne.

Par le biais de ces affectations, Cuso International met en relation des volontaires avec des organisations partenaires à la recherche de compétences et d’expertise spécifiques. Les volontaires en ligne peuvent travailler de manière autonome sur des affectations bien définies ou collaborer virtuellement avec un volontaire sur le terrain, ce qui leur permet de s’impliquer de manière significative dans le travail de développement international tout en restant basés au Canada.

Nous vous invitons à partager vos habiletés et à expliquer en quoi votre parcours professionnel, votre éducation, votre expérience de bénévolat ou votre expérience professionnelle peuvent contribuer aux priorités de nos partenaires.

Habiletés et domaines recherchés par nos partenaires

  • Communication et médias numériques (communication, réseaux sociaux, conception graphique, création de contenu)
  • Recherche et soutien à la gestion des connaissances (recherche documentaire, collecte de données, synthèses, aide à la rédaction de rapports)
  • L'égalité de genres, jeunesse et développement communautaire (soutien GESI, engagement des jeunes, initiatives pour le bien-être communautaire)
  • Suivi et soutien en matière de données (assistance MEAL, analyse de données, documentation)
  • Technologies de l'information et soutien numérique (soutien informatique, assistance aux systèmes de données, outils numériques)
  • Soutien aux programmes et aux projets (développement de projets, coordination, aide à la planification, logistique, établissement de rapports)
  • Développement commercial et entrepreneuriat (Développement d'entreprise, entrepreneuriat des jeunes, l'engagement du secteur privé)
  • Développement économique et moyens de subsistance (employabilité, préparation de la main-d'œuvre, développement axé sur le marché, résilience économique)
  • Développement de partenariats et mobilisation des ressources (soutien à la collecte de fonds, engagement des parties prenantes, création de partenariats)
  • Conception de programmes et de formations (EFTP, conception de programmes d'études, alignement sur le marché du travail, élaboration de formations)
  • Suivi, évaluation et mesure de l'impact (conception MEAL, cadres d'apprentissage, analyse de données)
  • Systèmes numériques et stratégie en matière de données (systèmes d'information, transformation numérique, prise de décision fondée sur les données)
  • Environnement, changements climatiques et durabilité (adaptation aux changements climatiques, programmes environnementaux, développement durable)

Principales responsabilités

Les responsabilités sont adaptées en fonction du niveau d'études, de l'expérience et des besoins des partenaires. Les bénévoles de niveau universitaire peuvent se voir confier des responsabilités techniques, analytiques ou stratégiques supplémentaires, en accord avec leur expertise.

  • Soutenir la mise en œuvre de projets et d’initiatives menés par les partenaires grâce à une collaboration à distance
  • Contribuer à la recherche, à l’analyse des données, à la production de rapports et à la documentation
  • Aider à la planification, à la coordination et à l’organisation de réunions ou d’ateliers virtuels
  • Soutenir l’élaboration de supports de communication et de partage des connaissances, notamment des rapports, des notes d’information, des présentations ou du contenu numérique
  • Contribuer aux activités de suivi, d’évaluation et d’apprentissage, y compris le suivi des données et la réflexion
  • Mettre en pratique ses connaissances universitaires et ses habiletés professionnelles pour renforcer les capacités et les systèmes des partenaires
  • Collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multiculturelles réparties sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires
  • Participer activement à des activités d’apprentissage virtuel, de réflexion, de mentorat et de développement professionnel
  • Respecter les valeurs de Cuso International en matière d’égalité de genres, d’Inclusion, de redevabilité et d’engagement éthique

Exigences

  • Conditions d'admissibilité : Seuls les citoyens canadiens et les résidents permanents du Canada peuvent postuler
  • Une expérience professionnelle d'au moins deux ans est requise, ainsi qu'un diplôme universitaire ou professionnel

A propos de nous

Cuso International (Cuso) est une organisation internationale de coopération et de développement basée au Canada qui œuvre à créer des opportunités sociales et économiques pour les groupes méritant l'équité. Forts de plus de soixante ans d'expérience, nous relevons les défis mondiaux en nous attaquant aux causes profondes des inégalités. En collaboration avec nos partenaires, nous nous concentrons sur les efforts visant à améliorer la résilience économique, à promouvoir l'équité et l'inclusion pour tous et à faire progresser l'action climatique. Nous croyons qu'en partageant nos compétences et habiletés, nous pouvons bâtir un avenir meilleur. Guidée par ses valeurs de courage, d'inclusion, de durabilité et de redevabilité, Cuso combine des stratégies innovantes et des partenariats durables pour créer un changement significatif et durable dans les communautés d'Afrique, d'Amérique latine, des Caraïbes et du Canada.

Requirements

Sélection et présélection

Si vous êtes présélectionné, vous devrez :

  • Fournir deux références professionnelles et une référence personnelle
  • Passer un test d'évaluation linguistique lors de l'entretien téléphonique initial
  • Accepter de respecter la politique de protection contre l'exploitation et les abus sexuels (PSEA) et le code de conduite

Inclusion et accessibilité : Cuso accueille les candidats issus de milieux diversifiés et de groupes méritant l'équité. Nous fournissons des aménagements raisonnables tout au long du processus de recrutement et d'affectation. Si vous avez des besoins en matière d'accessibilité, veuillez nous contacter pour obtenir de l'aide.

This role focuses heavily on professional liability while also encompassing all lines of property and casualty coverage needed by multi-location veterinary practices.

The National Practice Account Manager will serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams, practice owners, and risk managers delivering customized insurance and risk management solutions that align with the evolving needs of this growing segment.

  • Lead renewal efforts for large, complex accounts.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAt Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: we organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners’ capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together. We’ve built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other’s wins.

About the Position

The Sr. Finance Operations Manager is a key individual contributor on the Finance & Accounting Team, responsible for the day-to-day financial operations that keep the organization running accurately and compliantly. This role has primary ownership of billing and collections, sales tax compliance, AR and revenue reconciliations, and vital parts of our month-end close operations, while also supporting the FP&A processes and management reporting that inform leadership decisions. This is an operational role at its core, with meaningful analytical responsibility layered on top.

Working closely with the Director of Finance & Accounting, the Sr. Finance Operations Manager owns the execution layer of the finance function: ensuring billing goes out on time, collections are actively managed, sales tax filings are accurate, reconciliations are clean, and the close runs smoothly. This role also supports the budget and forecast cycle, grant reporting, partisan electioneering spend analysis, and financial dashboard maintenance, freeing the Director to focus on strategic financial leadership. Please note that this is an individual contributor role without people management responsibility.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, process-driven finance professional with strong accounting fundamentals and enough analytical capability to own reporting and FP&A support. They take genuine pride in operational accuracy: billing that goes out correctly, reconciliations that close clean, and compliance filings that are never late. They bring the initiative to improve processes and the judgment to escalate when something needs senior attention.

Job Level: P4

What You’ll Do

Accounting & Reconciliations

  • Own AR, revenue, and deferred revenue reconciliations end-to-end, preparing monthly reconciliations, investigating variances, and ensuring accurate revenue recognition in accordance with applicable accounting standards;
  • Prepare and issue customer and partner billings; monitor collections and follow up on outstanding receivables to ensure timely collection;
  • Support month-end close by preparing assigned journal entries, maintaining close checklists, and coordinating with the Accountant to ensure timely completion of all close tasks;
  • Perform balance sheet account reconciliations for assigned accounts; investigate and resolve discrepancies independently; and
  • Review and confirm sales and use tax calculations and filings through Avalara; maintain supporting documentation and schedules.

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Support administration of the annual budget and rolling forecast cycles, including data entry and validation in Vena, coordinating inputs from business leaders, and ensuring accuracy of consolidated outputs;
  • Prepare and distribute monthly budget variance analyses for budget managers and leadership with clear explanations of key drivers;
  • Maintain and update PowerBI financial dashboards; identify opportunities to improve the relevance and usability of financial reporting for non-finance audiences;
  • Build and maintain ad hoc financial models to support strategic decisions, scenario planning, and investment analysis as requested by the Director or leadership team; and
  • Lead partisan electioneering spend analysis and maintain supporting documentation and schedules required for compliance reporting.

Grant & Compliance Reporting

  • Maintain grant expense tracking schedules across all active grants; ensure expenses are properly coded, allocated, and reconciled against grant budgets;
  • Prepare the financial portions of grant reports in partnership with the Director and program teams; ensure reports are accurate, complete, and submitted on time;
  • Support preparation of audit schedules, supporting documentation, and responses to auditor inquiries for assigned areas; and
  • Assist with 990 and tax filing preparation by pulling required data, preparing supporting schedules, and coordinating documentation.

Payroll & Treasury Support

  • Partner with HR and People Operations (including relevant business leaders) to ensure payroll allocations are accurate and entered into Vena on time, and
  • Maintain data integrity between TriNet, Vena, and Intacct.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Maintain data integrity across financial systems (Sage Intacct, Vena, Bill.com, PowerBI); identify and escalate discrepancies or systemic issues;
  • Identify opportunities to streamline or improve recurring financial processes, reporting workflows, or reconciliation templates; lead implementation of improvements within their scope; and
  • Maintain organized, auditable financial records and documentation in accordance with internal controls and nonprofit accounting standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience;
  • 5–7 years of progressive finance or accounting experience with confident, independent ownership of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis) and accounting operations (reconciliations, close support, journal entries);
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and nonprofit accounting fundamentals;
  • Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including financial modeling and complex reconciliation work;
  • Experience with ERP systems (Sage Intacct preferred) and financial planning tools (Vena, or similar);
  • Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deliverables across competing deadlines;
  • Effective communication with the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance colleagues; and
  • Comfort working independently and taking ownership of processes without close supervision.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in a nonprofit organization, including exposure to grant accounting, restricted fund tracking, and 501(c)(3)/(c)(4) structures;
  • Familiarity with sales tax compliance and revenue recognition requirements;
  • Experience with PowerBI or comparable data visualization tools;
  • Exposure to payroll systems, PEO’s and allocation methodologies (e.g., TriNet);
  • Experience supporting external audits through schedule preparation and auditor coordination; and/or
  • Prior experience improving or documenting accounting or FP&A processes and controls.

Talented Finance Managers come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Benefits

Location and Compensation

The Sr. Finance Operations Manager is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package (detail below), open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The salary for this position is $127,075. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas don’t come from a single person or ideology — they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our team’s diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Murmuration is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally of race, gender, color, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, disability, political affiliation and national origin. jobs.description:
Statistiker:in (m/w/d)

Ab 4.500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.

Konkret heißt das: Du übernimmst Projekte von der ersten Methodendiskussion bis zur finalen Abgabe. Du analysierst Daten (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA — je nachdem, was das Projekt verlangt), überarbeitest wissenschaftliche Texte, erklärst Doktorand:innen Methoden ruhig und klar, gibst Feedback, hältst Termine ein und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne dass jemand dich an die Hand nehmen muss.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.

Was du machst

  • Mediziner:innen durch den kompletten Promotionsprozess führen — Methodik, Statistik, Schreiben, Struktur

  • Statistische und qualitative Auswertungen liefern (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA)

  • Doktorand:innen Methoden geduldig und klar erklären — schriftlich und im Gespräch

  • Wissenschaftliche Texte überarbeiten, Feedback geben, methodische Sauberkeit sicherstellen

  • Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren — Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

  • Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

  • Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet — nicht nur im Studium.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Nachhilfelehrer:in, Übungsleiter:in, Werkstudent:in im Lehrstuhl-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wer Lernenden schon einmal Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Emotionale Stabilität. Wenn ein:e Klient:in panisch wird, bleibst du ruhig. Wenn drei Mandate parallel brennen, sortierst du methodisch, statt dich anstecken zu lassen. Du nimmst Fehler sachlich, nicht persönlich.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig — auch wenn niemand drüberguckt.

  • Belastbarkeit in intensiven Phasen — keine Schönwetter-Mentalität.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und gegenüber Senior-Klient:innen klar, aber respektvoll argumentieren können.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Atmosphäre.

Berufserfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wir nehmen auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit starkem Tutor-Track. Mit 2-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in datenorientierten Bereichen (Marktforschung, Pharma-Innendienst, Junior Analytics, klinische Studien) bist du im Vorteil.

Was wir bieten

  • Geld: Ab 4.500 € brutto, reale Steigerung in den ersten 6–12 Monaten nach Ergebnissen

  • Aufstieg nach Leistung: Wer liefert, kommt schnell hoch — Zugehörigkeit zählt nicht

  • Echte Verantwortung: Eigene Projekte, eigene Kunden, eigene Entscheidungen — ab Tag 1

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

  • Entwicklung: Methodisch, technisch und unternehmerisch — du wächst hier real

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Akademiker:innen, die in der Forschungsblase bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Keine Leute, die "Work-Life-Balance" auf das Stundenkonto reduzieren. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und dafür entsprechend bezahlt werden will.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges und persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du in eine kleine Firma willst — nicht in einen Konzern oder die Uni.

  2. Was du in den nächsten 12 Monaten konkret erreichen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

jobs.excerpt: Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need youSpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars.
jobs.description:
Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

Pharma companies use event platforms as registration forms while request, approval, budget, HCP registration, transfer of value (ToV), and reporting run in Excel and at agencies. We are building Onomi 360, the life-sciences strategic meetings management (SMM) product, to replace the incumbent event platform in that space. First accounts already run their meeting requests and approvals in Onomi 360; the demand is validated and the trajectory is exciting.

Your focus will be MeetingsEQ, the SMM layer of Onomi 360: one front door for every request, approval and budget as configuration, unified HCP identity, per-attendee ToV allocation, and engagement and spend flowing back into the CRM without re-keying. The customer's CRM and master data stay where they are; the event platform behind the meetings program is where we play. AI-assisted development is how we work, and you will have real freedom to use it.

This position is the ideal role for a hands-on product leader from the life-sciences meetings, compliance, or HCP-data world who would rather ship and test than talk about the problem, and who wants to own one product end to end and see the process they once operated replaced with a modern, AI-first workflow.

As a Senior Product Manager, Onomi 360, you will be reporting to the VP Product. Your time will be spent on:

  • [35%] Defining the detailed product. Turn customer workbooks, operating procedures, RFP requirements, and our capability map into roadmap priorities and build-ready specifications.
  • [30%] Shipping. Work daily with design and engineering in the Onomi 360 codebase: thin production slices, prototypes, scope calls, validation in the running product. Daily AI-based prototyping and customer validation.
  • [25%] Customers and partners. Work with meetings operations, compliance, medical affairs, finance, agencies, and the customer’s data team. Define how Onomi 360 works with Veeva, Salesforce, Snowflake, and consent, and own the venue-sourcing and fair-market-value partner integrations.
  • [10%] Product truth. Keep what we claim, what we demo, and what we ship documented, clear and moving in the right direction.

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first month, you will:

  • Take over the first customer’s move from their meeting request form to Onomi 360: spec, build, history migration, customer session.
  • Get set up with AI-based toolkit and the Onomi 360 codebase, and use both in your daily work.
  • Meet the early access customers (design partners) for Onomi 360.

After 3 months, you will have:

  • The first customer live on meeting request and approvals in Onomi 360, measured against their baseline.
  • The roadmap priorities for the next two quarters defined, and the first priorities specified to build depth with engineering.
  • A clean separation everyone uses: aspirational (slides), forward-looking (prototype-based demo), and committed (roadmap and backlog).

After 6 months, you will have:

  • The full end-to-end MeetingsEQ product specified and engineering-reviewed, request through approval, budget, HCP registration, ToV, and reporting.
  • One customer replacing Excel with the Onomi 360 ToV module, and the first live account expanded from request and approval into budget, ToV, or venue sourcing.

After 12 months, you will have:

  • One customer closing a full ToV reporting cycle in Onomi 360 instead of Excel.
  • Three accounts running request to closure in production, and the org-wide calendar or HCP engagement view used outside compliance.
  • Onomi 360 winning the meetings-management scope in RFPs.

What you need to be great at

  • Life-sciences meetings, compliance, or transparency operations. You have built or operated workflows spanning approval, budgeting, ToV, and closure, and you know what EFPIA and Sunshine disclosure mean in practice.
  • HCP data and integration fluency. Identity across Veeva, Salesforce, OneKey, and NPI; match rates; what a data team expects from a write-back.
  • Domain-to-product translation. A messy operating process becomes states, rules, configuration, permissions, and audit events, with regulation separated from customer policy.
  • Sequencing. The smallest production slice that proves the model without hiding the hard architectural or compliance question.
  • Bias to execute. You ship, prototype, and put things in front of users in days, not spend weeks describing the problem. You drive decisions to a close and pull others along.
  • Precise writing and direct communication. Specs detailed enough to build and review, plain words, disagreement in the open.
  • Technical and AI fluency. You work in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, you understand code, data flows, and architecture well enough to challenge an engineering design. You know the software development lifecycle deeply, from RFC and specification through review, release, and support. AI takes you from evidence to a testable artifact in hours.

What we want to hear about

  1. Life-sciences meetings and transfer of value. Tell us about a meetings or transfer-of-value process you built or ran end to end, from request through approval, budget, HCP registration, and disclosure. Where did it break, and what did you change? This is the process Onomi 360 replaces, and we want someone who has lived it.
  2. From operating process to product. Tell us about a messy process you turned into a product: which rules you made fixed, which you made configurable, what you integrated, and what you left manual. That translation is the heart of this role.
  3. Shipping fast. Tell us about the last thing you shipped or prototyped within two weeks of first hearing the problem. What did you skip, and what did users do with it? Here you put working software in front of pharma design partners every few weeks, not slides.
  4. Building with AI. Tell us about something you built yourself with Claude Code or another AI tool that changed a product decision, and what it taught you about the code or the architecture underneath. AI-assisted development is how we build, and you will have real freedom to use it.

Fluent English (written and spoken). Remote, based in Europe or in the US Eastern or Central time zones, with about 10-20 % travel to design partners and industry events.

jobs.title: DSP Designer
jobs.excerpt: Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose.
jobs.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The DSP Designer plays a key role in developing and delivering complex signal processing algorithms for Fidus clients, from concept through simulation, fixed-point implementation, and hardware bring-up. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus FPGA/hardware teams to design algorithms, perform quantization and bit-width analysis, and translate DSP concepts into feasible hardware architectures.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys moving between application domains (communications, radar/sensing, industrial, medical), is comfortable working across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary, and takes pride in producing well-documented, bit-true designs.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and simulate DSP algorithms (equalization, filtering, estimation, detection) in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python, from concept through fixed-point validation
  • Perform quantization/bit-width analysis and produce bit-true fixed-point models suitable for HDL implementation
  • Collaborate with FPGA/HDL and hardware teams to translate algorithms into feasible hardware architectures (pipelining, MAC/resource budgeting, timing closure)
  • Support HDL verification through golden-model test vectors and co-simulation
  • Support lab bring-up, characterization, and tuning of DSP-based hardware against real-world channel/sensor behavior
  • Adapt existing DSP toolkits to new client domains and standards across multiple engagements (e.g., communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor)
  • Document algorithm design decisions, trade-offs, and validation results for client and internal reference

Who You are:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related field
  • Strong foundation in signals and systems: Fourier/Z-transform, digital filter design (FIR/IIR), sampling theory
  • Practical experience with estimation/detection theory (e.g., matched filtering, MMSE, Kalman filtering) or adaptive filtering (LMS/RLS)
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python for algorithm design and simulation
  • Experience with fixed-point conversion and quantization trade-off analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary (collaborating directly with HDL/FPGA teams)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - ability to explain algorithm trade-offs to non-DSP stakeholders
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in one or more of: optical/wireless communications, radar/sensing, motor control, biomedical signal processing, semiconductor test
  • Experience with high-speed SerDes and PAM4 signaling (e.g., PCIe Gen6, 400G/800G Ethernet electrical) - equalization (FFE/CTLE/DFE), link training, and FEC awareness
  • Familiarity with AMD's Adaptive Computing portfolio (Versal, Alveo) or embedded x86 product lines
  • Familiarity with HDL Coder, HLS, or Simulink-to-HDL co-simulation workflows
  • Hands-on lab experience (scope, VNA, BERT, or domain-equivalent test equipment)
  • Exposure to safety-critical or regulated development processes (DO-178C/DO-254, ISO 26262, IEC 62304/60601) - valued for A&D, automotive, and medtech engagements specifically
  • Experience adapting quickly across multiple industries or client domains (consulting/services background a plus)
  • Exposure to AI/ML techniques applied to signal processing on FPGAs, GPUs, NPUs, or CPUs
  • Experience with dedicated DSP processors (e.g., Analog Devices, Texas Instruments)
  • Experience with RF front-end systems and data converter interfaces (ADC/DAC), including digital up/down-conversion (DUC/DDC)

Location and travel: Fully remote role and requires around 15% travel, including domestic and international.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry—our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can't wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our Working at Fidus page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Tax Accountant (Corporate & VAT) - UK
jobs.excerpt: GoGlobal is establishing an in-house UK corporate tax and VAT capability to support a growing portfolio of clients.
jobs.description:
GoGlobal is establishing an in-house UK corporate tax and VAT capability to support a growing portfolio of clients. The role combines hands-on tax compliance delivery with technical support to the business-development process.

The postholder prepares and reviews UK Corporation Tax and VAT returns and files them with HMRC to deadline, while maintaining the supporting accounting records. In addition, the postholder provides technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing, and advises clients across corporate tax and VAT.

The role sits within the Accounting, Tax & Payments function and reports to the Regional Product Owner (EMEA). Two positions are available, at Senior and Junior level, to provide cover, resilience and a route for progression. The working language is English and no additional language is required, giving access to a broad candidate pool from UK practice and industry.

GoGlobal acts as its clients’ UK tax agent, and is registered with HMRC and supervised for anti-money-laundering purposes in accordance with HMRC’s Standard for Agents. The postholder operates within this framework.

Roles & Responsibilities

Corporate Tax Compliance

• Prepare and review UK Corporation Tax returns (CT600) and computations, including iXBRL tagging, and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Address capital allowances, tax adjustments to the accounts, loss and group relief, and Research & Development claims where relevant.

• Manage Corporation Tax payment deadlines, including Quarterly Instalment Payments for larger companies.

VAT Compliance

• Prepare and review VAT returns under Making Tax Digital (MTD) and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Manage VAT registrations and de-registrations, and advise on schemes and treatments, including flat-rate, partial exemption, and place-of-supply and cross-border matters.

• Manage VAT deadlines, payments and reconciliations across the client portfolio.

Accounting and Statutory

• Prepare and review statutory accounts under UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105) and management accounts in support of the tax work.

• Support Companies House filings, including annual accounts and the confirmation statement, and maintain statutory records.

Business Development Support

• Provide technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing.

• Represent the tax function in client and prospective-client meetings, presenting GoGlobal’s UK capability accurately and credibly.

• Identify opportunities to extend GoGlobal services (entity management, payroll, accounting and Employer of Record) within the client portfolio.

• Contribute to service documentation, scoping templates and technical guidance for UK tax.

Client Relationship and Advisory

• Manage the relationships within an assigned client portfolio and provide proactive, practical UK tax and accounting advice.

• Resolve client queries and issues promptly, and communicate technical matters clearly and commercially.

HMRC, Controls and Quality

• Manage HMRC correspondence, agent authorisations (form 64-8), enquiries and filing calendars.

• Apply four-eyes review, GoGlobal internal controls and data-protection standards, and operate within anti-money-laundering requirements and HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Key Performance Indicators

• Corporation Tax, VAT and statutory-accounts filings completed accurately and on time, with no missed HMRC or Companies House deadlines.

• Contribution to business development, measured through proposals supported and new or extended work won.

• Client satisfaction and retention across the portfolio.

• Turnaround times and quality of work, including levels of rework.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

• Qualified in UK corporate tax and VAT: ATT (Association of Taxation Technicians), or qualified by experience in corporate tax and VAT compliance.

• No statutory licence is required in the United Kingdom to prepare or file Corporation Tax or VAT returns. A chartered-accountant qualification (ACA or ACCA) or CPA is not required, as this is a tax role rather than an audit role.

• CTA (Chartered Tax Adviser) is desirable, particularly for the Senior position. Candidates for the Junior position may be ATT-qualified or part-qualified and studying.

• GoGlobal provides the anti-money-laundering supervision and HMRC agent registration; the postholder is expected to meet fit-and-proper standards and to work within HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Core Requirements

• Practical working knowledge of UK Corporation Tax (CT600, computations and iXBRL) and VAT (MTD), together with UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105).

• Familiarity with HMRC online services, Making Tax Digital and Companies House filings, and competence with tax and accounting software (for example Alphatax, Digita, CCH, TaxCalc, Xero or Sage).

• Commercial awareness and a client-facing manner, with the confidence to support business development through scoping, pricing and client meetings.

• Strong written and spoken English, and a well-organised, accurate and deadline-driven approach.

• The right to work in the United Kingdom.

Preferred

• Experience in practice (an accountancy or tax firm) managing a portfolio of clients, ideally including international or foreign-owned entities.

• Exposure to payroll and PAYE, Research & Development relief, or cross-border and international tax.

• Experience contributing to proposals, pricing or business development, and with cloud accounting software such as Xero.

Who Thrives in This Role

• Technically strong tax professionals who are also commercially minded and comfortable supporting business development.

• Client-facing advisers who enjoy variety across corporate tax, VAT and accounting, and managing a growing portfolio.

• Clear communicators who can make technical matters simple and useful for clients.

Benefits

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.
    • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations

jobs.title: Chief of Staff for US D2C Supplement Brand (Latam, EE- Remote)
jobs.excerpt: About PairedPaired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!
jobs.description:
About Paired

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!

We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with remarkable companies in need of their skills. Our goal is to create fulfilling job opportunities for professionals around the world.

About our Client

They're a direct-to-consumer subscription brand that has gone from zero to a multiple nine-figure run rate in under three years — completely bootstrapped, with a small, lean team spread across the globe. No outside capital, no board, no bureaucracy. We sell across our own D2C site, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, with a subscription retention engine underneath it all.

They grew fast enough that structure never caught up with scale. That is the problem this role exists to solve.

The role

The CEO currently has roughly 25 people, agencies, and suppliers reporting to him across Customer Service, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Operations, Retention, and Finance — plus a running list of ~20 ad hoc growth projects. There is no layer between him and the work. Every decision, follow-up, deadline, blocker, and loose thread routes to one inbox.

The Chief of Staff is that layer. You will own the operating system of the company: who owns what, how they're measured, what they committed to, and whether it actually happened. You'll also own a rotating portfolio of high-leverage projects end to end, and you'll handle the CEO's calendar, inbox, and meeting follow-up so his time goes to product, partnerships, and P&L.

This is not a coordination job. You are expected to get into the weeds, do the work yourself, push people, and raise the standard. You start reporting directly to the CEO with influence rather than formal authority — and as you prove you can handle it, you'll be given the authority to escalate, reassign, and put underperformers on a plan.

Where this goes: if you crush this role, the path is C-suite or President within two years. That is a real offer, not a recruiting line.

What You'll Do

  • Own accountability and urgency across every function. Each person and agency has KPIs, deadlines, and commitments. You track them, follow up individually, unblock what's stuck, enforce urgency, and make sure the owner knows they own the outcome. Functions include TikTok Shop (8 people), Amazon (agency of 5), Operations (3 suppliers, 3 in-house), Retention (email agency, in-house dev, media buyer), and Finance (3 in-house, 1 agency).
  • Build the process map of the entire business. Every role titled and defined, every responsibility documented, every recurring workflow written up as an SOP, every doc and tracker findable, a clear reporting and ownership structure, and clear written criteria for how someone earns a bonus, earns a promotion, or gets let go.
  • Triage everything currently flowing to the CEO. For each item: handle it yourself, route it to the right manager, automate it, or kill it. The goal is that it stops reaching him.
  • Own high-leverage projects end to end. You'll be handed ad hoc projects — growth initiatives, new channel tests, vendor negotiations, systems builds — with a goal and little else. You scope them, run them, hire or coordinate whoever is needed, and report meaningful progress in a weekly check-in without being managed step by step.
  • Turn conversations into tracked action. Sit in on calls, capture decisions and action items from meetings, Slack, and WhatsApp, assign owners and dates, and chase them to done.
  • Run the CEO's calendar, inbox, and meeting prep. Full ownership — scheduling, prioritization, prep material, follow-up.
  • Raise the bar on the people around you. Give direct feedback, flag underperformance early, and help managers hold their own teams accountable rather than doing it for them forever.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Demonstrated ability to learn fast and independently. If we hand you ClickUp on a Friday and say "know it by Monday," you find YouTube tutorials, book a consultant call, and figure it out yourself in a few hours. We don't care what tools you've used — we care that you can teach yourself anything.
  • You're smart and hands-on. You need to reason through complex business problems and handle people well enough that they want to deliver for you.
  • Genuine humility. Zero ego. You take direct feedback well, ask for more of it, and are never "above" the work. If a spreadsheet needs cleaning at 11 PM, you clean it.
  • Willingness to do the work yourself. This role manages and executes. Delegating without getting your hands dirty is a disqualifier.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and total ownership. Given a problem in a domain you know nothing about, your reaction is excitement, not fear.
  • Directness. You give and receive blunt feedback without it becoming personal or political.
  • Real work capacity. This is a 50-hour minimum role with frequent nights and weekends. We're a startup that moves quickly and we're honest about what that costs.
  • Availability during US Eastern hours within the 9:00 AM – 12:00 AM ET window.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice-to-have

  • A track record of excellence in a competitive environment. Top marks academically, a strong university, high-level competitive sports or esports, elite early-career roles, a company you built — something that shows you've been in a room full of winners and held your own.
  • E-commerce experience — D2C, Amazon, or TikTok Shop especially.
  • Subscription or retention business experience.
  • Prior Chief of Staff, founder's associate, consulting, or investment banking background.
  • Experience building SOPs, process documentation, or operating cadences from scratch.
  • Experience managing agencies and offshore contractors.

Note on weighting: soft skills outrank hard skills here. A candidate with less e-commerce experience but smart, hands on, humble, faster learning speed, and a stronger record of excellence beats a domain expert who's rigid or ego-driven. Hire for the athlete.

Benefits

  • Base: $6,000 – $8,000 USD/month, depending on experience (negotiable for the right fit!)
  • Bonus: 20% of base annually, tied to project completion and KPI attainment
  • Structure: W-2 or 1099 — your choice
  • Remote: Work from anywhere, as long as you cover Eastern hours
  • Growth: Direct, stated path to C-suite or President within two years for the right performer

The Culture

They move fast, communicate directly, and don't sugarcoat feedback. There are no politics, no vanity titles, and no tenure — you don't get status here for having been around. You keep what you kill: results drive promotions, bonuses, and authority.

Everyone here holds absurdly high standards for themselves and the people around them, and the standard keeps going up. Good is never the finish line. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't the right fit. If it sounds like the environment you've been looking for, it's rare that you get it at this scale with this little bureaucracy.

Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

As an E-Content Specialist, your primary responsibility is to help build and maintain a comprehensive, high-quality Global Knowledge Base (GKB), a centralized system that stores and manages metadata about electronic resources to ensure accurate linking to full text, to support customer needs. You will accomplish this by establishing quality data feeds with external data partners, analyzing and manipulating metadata for inclusion in the GKB, and taking ownership of identifying, adding, and maintaining all necessary collections to ensure their full and accurate representation. Additionally, you will resolve internal and external reported issues in a timely manner by applying strong research and critical-thinking skills, conducting root-cause analysis to identify trends, and implementing proactive solutions to reduce reoccurring issues.

This remote position is U.S.-based only (excluding U.S. territories).

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with global providers, using effective written and verbal communication to resolve data issues and obtain the metadata required for GKB maintenance.
  • Analyze publisher‑supplied metadata to ensure it is complete, high‑quality, and accurate, proactively identifying gaps and taking action to remediate them.
  • Create, load, and maintain collections in the GKB, managing associated metadata including descriptions, subject classifications, alternate names, and related attributes to support accurate indexing and discovery.
  • Develop and maintain internal documentation that describes how metadata should be transformed and manipulated for loading.
  • Research and source required metadata when it is not provided, ensuring it is properly structured and successfully loaded into the GKB.
  • Prioritize and manage weekly tasks, reporting progress and concerns in daily team workload meetings.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members and cross‑functional partners to meet individual, team, and organizational goals.

Your Team

You will be welcomed as a member of the Global Knowledge Base Team (a team of about 30 people) and the larger Product Management organization. Our team enjoys the flexibility and greater work life balance working remotely offers. There will be ample resources, tools, training, and support to ensure your success as an E-Content Specialist and your developme

About You

  • 2+ years of experience working with large datasets, metadata, or electronic resources
  • 2+ years of experience coordinating with third‑party vendors and managing high‑volume written and verbal communications
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to use VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and advanced functions/formulas, as well as experience working with datasets exceeding 50,000 rows

What Sets You Apart

  • Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills; technologically savvy

  • Fast learner who adapts well to changing priorities
  • Proven attention to detail, maintaining high data quality standards (e.g., minimal error rates, consistent formatting, accurate classifications)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, PowerPoint, Access, OneNote, Word, and SharePoint

Description

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for a Learning Experience Designer to join our B2B Curriculum team and develop technical / AI-focused courses for corporate clients. You will turn client needs and subject-matter expertise into practical, scalable learning experiences and continuously improve them using learner feedback and expert recommendations.

This is a full-time remote contract position. After the Online Introductory Call, candidates will be required to complete a test assignment.

What you will do

  • Own the end-to-end development of new B2B courses, from learning needs analysis and high-level design to final course documentation, in collaboration with Product Managers and subject-matter experts.
  • Build course Skill Trees and map learning outcomes across the course, modules, and individual lessons.
  • Create educational content, practice exercises, assessments, and learning aids based on materials provided by subject-matter experts.
  • Prepare clear briefs for designers and video editors, and develop outlines and facilitator materials for workshops, seminars, and other live formats.
  • Analyze each client’s learning needs, business goals, workflows, tools, operational constraints, and learner profiles together with Product Managers and client stakeholders.
  • Customize learning activities, case studies, learning paths, curriculum structure, and schedules to reflect authentic client tasks and the needs of different roles.
  • Continuously improve the learning experience by auditing cognitive load, motivation, difficulty, and alignment with learning outcomes; use learner feedback and expert recommendations to update content and maintain an improvement backlog.

Requirements

Must have:

  • At least three years of experience as an Instructional Designer, Learning Experience Designer, Learning Content Developer, Program Designer, or in a comparable role.
  • Proven experience applying modern learning experience design models, methodologies, and frameworks to the development of complex skills.
  • Experience structuring end-to-end learning experiences, including building Skill Trees and Learning Journey Maps and mapping learning outcomes.
  • Ability to create different forms of educational content, including long reads, projects, practice tasks, infographics, and other learning aids.
  • Experience designing and integrating skills and knowledge assessments into a course.
  • English proficiency at C1 level (strong B2 users with a good fit in other requirements are welcome to apply, too).

Nice to have:

  • Strong familiarity with popular AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Claude Design). Experience creating your own agents or workflows, or some familiarity with coding, is a strong plus.
  • Experience adapting curricula for B2B clients based on their business goals, workflows, learner profiles, and operational constraints.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, full-time collaboration.
  • Performance appraisals twice a year and a bonus system.
  • Digital office. We use modern digital tools like Miro, Notion, Slack, etc., to keep our teamwork smooth.
  • Have the freedom to work professionally. We trust your experience and don't believe in micromanaging.
  • Room to grow. Our product is expanding rapidly, so it's a great chance to join and challenge yourself.
  • Diverse and close-knit team. We're spread out across the world: Europe, Asia and Latin America.
