jobs.title: Project Management Analyst / Scrum Master
jobs.excerpt: OverviewNakupuna Companies is seeking a Project Management Analyst / Scrum Master to support a multidisciplinary Agile DevSecOps team delivering Informatica data-governance and MuleSoft integration capabilities for NAVSUP Business Systems Center.
jobs.description:
Overview

Nakupuna Companies is seeking a Project Management Analyst / Scrum Master to support a multidisciplinary Agile DevSecOps team delivering Informatica data-governance and MuleSoft integration capabilities for NAVSUP Business Systems Center. The individual will provide disciplined Agile facilitation, project analysis, and delivery coordination so the team can convert PWS requirements and Government priorities into transparent, executable, and traceable work.

The individual will facilitate Scrum and SAFe-like practices; develop and maintain the Agile roadmap, integrated schedule, backlog, dashboards, and project controls in Azure DevOps; coordinate deliverables, risks, dependencies, reviews, and status reporting; and maintain the documentation workflow. The position will work closely with Government representatives, architects, engineers, administrators, cybersecurity personnel, data specialists, and external system stakeholders. Technical and security owners will validate substantive content, and Government officials will retain approval, acceptance, contractual, and funding authority.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to mission requirements and reasonable accommodation.

  • Facilitate Agile Scrum and SAFe-like delivery activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, team coordination, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and program-increment planning support, as applicable to NAVSUP practices.
  • Develop and maintain the Agile Project Roadmap with the team, including the project scope, prioritized epics and features, integrated master schedule, major milestones and dependencies, PWS-aligned work breakdown structure, resource plan, communications plan, risk-management approach, quality-management approach, change-control process, and configuration-management approach.
  • Administer the NAVSUP Azure DevOps backlog by decomposing PWS requirements and deliverables into epics, features, user stories or product backlog items, tasks, and defects while maintaining bidirectional traceability to the governing PWS sections and deliverables.
  • Maintain current work-item ownership, estimates, remaining effort, status, start and finish dates, dependencies, acceptance criteria, risks, and approval status; configure dashboards and queries for burn-down, milestones, deliverables, blocked work, and risk visibility; and prepare required baseline and monthly ADO exports.
  • Coordinate work across Informatica, MuleSoft, AWS, database, testing, cybersecurity, documentation, training, and sustainment activities; identify cross-team dependencies and impediments; maintain action and decision records; and elevate issues promptly with recommended options.
  • Maintain the integrated deliverable schedule and review calendar; coordinate owners, contributors, acceptance criteria, draft and final reviews, comment resolution, resubmissions, and Government acceptance records without assuming Government approval authority.
  • Prepare the Monthly Status Report and supporting management data, including staffing, accomplishments, completion status, forecast dates, travel, issues and recommended solutions, plan or schedule changes, overdue Government dependencies, staffing adequacy, knowledge-transfer activity, property status, onboarding, certifications, and required training; coordinate invoice support with authorized contracts and billing personnel.
  • Maintain project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, changes, configuration-control actions, and lessons learned; assess schedule and delivery impacts; facilitate mitigation planning; and keep the risk register and related project-management documentation current.
  • Interview technical and cybersecurity subject-matter experts and develop, edit, organize, trace, and maintain required documentation, including plans, installation and configuration guides, integration runbooks, API specifications, OpenAPI/Swagger artifacts, security evidence, architecture diagrams, backup and recovery materials, training products, governance guides, and configuration records; ensure responsible owners validate technical content.
  • Manage document and knowledge repositories in Azure DevOps and associated wikis, including version history, templates, links, review status, publication, and traceability among requirements, work items, evidence, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate training and knowledge-transfer schedules, materials, demonstrations, recordings, attendance records, reports, FAQs, action items, and documentation updates so NAVSUP personnel receive current and maintainable operating information throughout the period of performance.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Skills/Qualifications:

In addition to being able to confidently perform the above job duties, the candidate should demonstrate the following:

  • Agile Delivery / Scrum - Applies servant-leadership practices, facilitates productive ceremonies, coaches the team on flow and commitments, supports capacity-based planning, and helps the team continuously improve without assuming the Government Product Owner role.
  • Project Analysis / Controls - Builds usable roadmaps, schedules, work breakdown structures, metrics, dashboards, risk registers, and decision-ready analyses; recognizes emerging schedule, staffing, dependency, quality, and scope concerns early.
  • Communication / Facilitation - Leads focused working sessions, elicits clear decisions and acceptance criteria, translates between technical and nontechnical stakeholders, documents outcomes, and follows through on commitments and unresolved actions.
  • Deliverable / Documentation Quality - Maintains disciplined traceability, version control, review workflows, accessibility, and deadline management; turns subject-matter input into clear products while ensuring technical owners validate substantive content.
  • Teamwork / Judgment - Creates accountability without relying on formal authority, removes impediments where possible, escalates issues constructively, protects role boundaries, and supports a collaborative relationship with Government and contractor stakeholders.

Education and Experience:

Education: A bachelor's degree in project management, business administration, information systems, computer science, technical communication, or a related field is preferred; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.

Required experience: The candidate must be able to demonstrate the following:

  • 3 years of demonstrated experience serving as a Scrum Master, Project Management Analyst, Project Coordinator, or similar delivery role on software, cloud, data, systems-integration, cybersecurity, or other technical programs.
  • Hands-on experience administering Agile work in Microsoft Azure DevOps or a comparable tool, including work-item hierarchies, backlogs, iteration planning, queries, dashboards, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and requirements-to-deliverable traceability.
  • Experience translating contractual or program requirements into roadmaps, integrated schedules, work breakdown structures, epics, features, user stories or product backlog items, tasks, milestones, and measurable completion criteria.
  • Experience facilitating sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, cross-functional working sessions, and stakeholder coordination while identifying and resolving impediments and dependencies.
  • Experience with project controls and reporting, including schedule management, deliverable tracking, risk and issue management, action and decision logs, change control, configuration control, status reporting, and performance metrics.
  • Strong technical writing, editing, organization, facilitation, and communication skills, with experience coordinating complex technical deliverables and obtaining content validation from engineering, cybersecurity, and other subject-matter experts.

Preferred experience: The following experience will strengthen the candidate's fit for this role:

  • Experience supporting Agile DevSecOps delivery involving AWS or AWS GovCloud, enterprise platforms, APIs, data governance, data integration, automated testing, RMF/ATO, or sustainment operations.
  • Experience developing or managing Government technical deliverables, monthly status reports, invoice-support documentation, review-comment matrices, controlled repositories, and audit-ready traceability.
  • Experience producing or coordinating technical plans, procedures, runbooks, architecture or process diagrams, training materials, and knowledge-transfer records.
  • Prior experience supporting the Department of Defense, Department of the Navy, NAVSUP, or another regulated Government technology environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, SharePoint or Flank Speed, and reporting or visualization tools used to supplement Azure DevOps project controls.

Certifications:

Required: 

  • Current DoD 8140.03 IAT Level II baseline certification at the start of performance: CompTIA Security+ CE or a PWS-listed substitute (CCNA, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, or CND). 
  • Certification as a Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM), along with a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certification, desired.

Clearance and access: This position requires U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain the favorable background investigation at the T3 level, CAC, SAAR, Government accounts, mandatory training, and system access required by NAVSUP.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).

Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations. Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality. Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs), Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. Develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development.
  • May be assigned to larger, more complex trials or may coordinate clinical activities for a team of CTMs across a portfolio of projects
  • May coach and mentor CTMs regarding functional clinical delivery, evaluation of project risks, and action implementation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a sharp, curious, technically-minded Junior Systems Administrator to join our team. This is an early-career position designed for a high-potential individual who is eager to manage and evolve the backbone of our business operations.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and software integration. You will be responsible for the health, security, and connectivity of our core platforms, ensuring that data flows cleanly across our ecosystem.

A note on experience with our specific platforms. This is a technical role and it requires real technical ability. You need to be able to read and write code, reason about how systems talk to each other, and work confidently in a command line, a log file, and an API. What you do not need is prior experience in Salesforce, AWS, or any other product on this page. Those are learnable, and we will teach them to you. If you have a solid technical foundation and a track record of picking up unfamiliar systems quickly, do not screen yourself out because you have never touched a Salesforce org.

Key Responsibilities

Investigation, Requirements, and Solutioning

  • Problem Investigation: Take ambiguous requests and unclear symptoms, trace them back to root cause, and explain what you found in plain language.
  • Requirements Gathering: Sit with stakeholders across the business, ask the questions that surface what they actually need (not just what they asked for), and turn that into a clear set of requirements.
  • Solution Design: Evaluate options, weigh tradeoffs, and recommend an approach. Then build it, test it, and see it through.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation for system architecture, integration mappings, and workflow logic.

Systems & Cloud Administration

  • Salesforce Administration: Act as a junior admin for the Salesforce environment, managing user permissions, configuration changes, and custom object maintenance.
  • AWS Support: Assist in the administration of Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, ensuring cloud services are secure, patched, and performing optimally.
  • System Security: Implement and monitor security best practices across all managed platforms to safeguard company and client data.

Integrations & Automation

  • API Management: Work directly with REST/SOAP APIs to maintain and troubleshoot integrations between diverse software platforms.
  • Platform Connectivity: Manage the connective tissue between Salesforce and our core tools: Slack, BambooHR, and QuickBooks.
  • Scripting & Automation: Write logic and scripts that automate manual workflows and improve data synchronization.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve integration failures or API bottlenecks to ensure high system availability.

Stakeholder Management & Prioritization

  • Communication: Act as a technical bridge between internal teams and external clients, translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Prioritization: Manage a diverse queue of technical tasks, balancing immediate support needs with long-term infrastructure projects.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science (preferred), Information Technology, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related technical field.
  • Working proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (JavaScript preferred, Python or similar accepted). You should be able to write a script that calls an API, parses the response, and handles an error, and you should be able to read code someone else wrote.
  • A solid understanding of API architecture: what REST and SOAP are, how authentication works, what a payload looks like, and how two systems exchange data.
  • Comfort working in a technical environment: command line, log files, stack traces, and vendor documentation.
  • Foundational understanding of core IT and cloud concepts such as networking basics, user access and permissions models, and security practices.

Preferred Qualifications

While this is an early-career role, professional IT experience, internships, help desk or support work, and personal development projects are all highly valued. Direct exposure to the Salesforce ecosystem, the AWS Management Console, or API testing tools is a plus and will shorten your ramp, but it will not outweigh technical fundamentals and the ability to learn.

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are seeking a data-driven and strategic Senior User Acquisition Manager to lead our Meta Ads efforts across the US region. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for scaling high-budget campaigns and optimizing complex funnels to drive enrollment for our high-value tech programs.

What you will do

  • Own the budget and paid strategy for the advanced programs line — roughly $200K/month today, scaling several times over by year-end.
  • Run Meta and Google (YouTube included) as core volume channels; open LinkedIn and run experiments in Reddit and Twitter.
  • Own campaign and ad-set architecture, plus the keep-or-kill calls: small batches, a data threshold before deciding, weekly cadence, an honest decision log.
  • Brief the content producer and judge the output on metrics — you don't write scripts or build pages, creatives, or dashboards yourself.
  • Own traffic quality rather than cost per lead: read sales call transcripts, see who actually shows up, and influence target-audience share.
  • Own attribution and conversion events — pixel and event setup, separate buying infrastructure, and reconciling the ad account against CRM and BI.

  • Comfort with narrow audiences and thin data, where judgment fills the gap statistics won't, and a clear answer to what "enough delivery to decide" means.
  • You know full-funnel economics — CAC, contribution, cohorts, lead-to-call, call-to-sale — and read CRM and BI data alongside the ad account.
  • Attribution, conversion events, pixels, and tracking QA are things you've owned, not things someone did for you.

We are actively seeking a Support Engineer, SAP ABAP/BTP. This is a remote position and can be based anywhere in Brazil.

Position Summary

The role of the Support Engineer ABAP / BTP is to provide exceptional remote-based support for mission-critical SAP applications as part of our global customer support team. The position has the responsibility for researching, troubleshooting, and supporting of multiple SAP modules for our global clients who use both 4.x and ECC environments. The role of the Support Engineer, SAP ABAP requires the expertise and skills to diagnose serious issues; then develop, test, package and deliver fixes for such issues in complex, integrated and highly configured environments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Understanding the needs and requirements of the clients by coordinating with their representatives and seeking clarity on every minute detail in order to provide the best possible solution.
  • Consulting with professionals from other departments and those working on specific SAP modules such as SAP FI/CO, MM, SD and Others to ensure a consistent experience to the various users on the client's side.

  • Ensuring that all programs are completed in schedule as per the client's guidelines and allocating appropriate resources to achieve this.
  • Providing technical support to the end users in the form of troubleshooting guidelines and modifications to the system after it has been delivered.
  • Design, build, and operate services on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma), including setup of Destinations, Connectivity/Cloud Connector, and XSUAA for secure on‑prem to cloud integrations.
  • Develop and expose APIs on BTP: design, implementation, and lifecycle management of OData/REST services, including API Management policies (authentication, throttling, masking).
  • Implement event‑driven integrations using SAP Event Mesh to decouple logistics/production flows and enable near real‑time processing.
  • Apply modern programming models: deliver cloud services with SAP CAP (Node/Java) and service exposure with ABAP RAP, aligned to ECC data structures.
  • Establish CI/CD for SAP development: configure and maintain gCTS/CTS+ pipelines, automated ATC quality checks, code reviews, and transport governance.
  • Optimize performance and stability: run SQLM/ST05/SAT traces, tune long‑running jobs/interfaces, and document remediations prior to production deployment.
  • Harden security and compliance: design role models and AUTHORITY‑CHECK strategy; manage secrets and audit logs on BTP; enforce privacy controls in custom apps.
  • Integrate with BW/Analytics: collaborate to create/adjust custom extractors, handle delta mechanisms and error recovery; ensure reliable data feeds for reporting.
  • Support Brazil localization scenarios: build and troubleshoot integrations for Nota Fiscal (NFe) and tax determination exits/BADIs across SD/MM billing and fiscal flows.
  • Own incident response under SLA: triage P1/P2 issues across ABAP + BTP stacks; provide runbooks, root‑cause analysis, and preventive actions.
  • Drive knowledge transfer: produce technical documentation and deliver KT sessions to support and functional teams; maintain solution and operational guides.
  • To stay updated with the latest technological advancement and changes in the world of SAP development and adapting to these changes by self-training and research work.
  • Other job-related duties and responsibilities may be assigned from time to time.

Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience in the field of ABAP and FIORI programming and SAP modules
  • 5+ years’ experience in BTP (administration and integration skills)
  • 3+ years knowledge of SAP systems such as FI/CO, MM and SD is also required
  • Prior experience in object-oriented programming, ABAP lists and other related fields
  • A track record of successful bug free codes written for clients
  • Hands-on experience with SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry, Destinations, Connectivity, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Design and exposure of OData/REST APIs and API Management on BTP.
  • Experience with SAP CAP (Node/Java) and ABAP RAP programming models.
  • Proven ability to develop and troubleshoot Brazil localization requirements (Nota Fiscal, tax determination, fiscal document processing).
  • Advanced performance analysis and optimization using SAP tools (SQLM, ST05, SAT, ATC).
  • Collaboration with BW/Analytics teams (custom extractors, ETL routines, error handling).
  • Security best practices for ABAP and BTP developments (authorization checks, secrets management, audit logging).
  • Experience working in highly customized environments (Z routines, user-exits, enhancements).
  • Ability to handle critical incidents and working under SLA-driven environments.
  • Proven track record in documentation and knowledge transfer activities (such as KT sessions, producing runbooks, and solution documentation).Deep working knowledge and understanding of supporting business processes
  • Analytical, logical problem resolution skills
  • SAP certification(s) preferred
  • Demonstrable history solving complex problems across multiple modules
  • Knowledge of maintenance/patching mechanics and SAP architecture.

Skills

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills in order to carry out their daily functions effectively.
  • Superb technical trouble-shooting skills ability to debug code and the tenacity for complex problem solving
  • Passionate focus on customer support and the ability to build long term, successful working relationships with Clients
  • Strong knowledge of key application functionality, tables and relationships
  • Deep knowledge of SAP customization/extension methodologies
  • Excellent development skills using SAP toolset
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and communication skills – verbal & written
  • Attention to detail and the ability to learn quick
  • Extreme focus on Client satisfaction
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally in high pressure situations

Preferred Qualifications

  • The best candidates will have extensive knowledge of multiple SAP modules across releases (4.x & ECC) including proficiency with SAP product module/suite business processes, navigation mechanics, configuration requirements, integration with other modules and knowledge of underlying technology
  • Knowledge of any Country Specific Solutions would be an advantage

Education

Language

Job Summary

As a Pilot Project Manager supporting the VA's Chief Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) office within the Strategic Planning Division (SPD) innovation engine aligned with VA Planning, Innovation & Modernization (PIM), you will lead the planning, execution, and performance tracking of healthcare pilot and innovation programs designed to improve Veterans' health outcomes and care delivery across VA facilities. This role operates at the intersection of federal healthcare policy and operational innovation, requiring close collaboration with VA program offices, senior executive stakeholders, and Congressional reporting chains to advance high-visibility transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate is a disciplined, detail-oriented project manager who thrives in complex, ambiguous federal healthcare environments and can translate program performance data into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and legislative audiences, especially with regard to the development of data-driven and value-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project management of VA healthcare pilot and innovation efforts, including scope definition, work planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination across program lifecycle phases. Develop, maintain, and deliver high-quality performance reports and program dashboards tailored for Senior Executive Service (SES) review, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with VA strategic priorities. Support the preparation of Congressional reporting packages, briefing materials, and responses to data calls, ensuring compliance with federal reporting standards and legislative requirements. Facilitate cross-functional working groups and pilot site coordination meetings, capturing action items, decisions, and risks while driving accountability among internal and external stakeholders. Monitor and evaluate pilot program performance metrics against defined success criteria, identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities for course correction or scale-up recommendations. Maintain comprehensive project documentation including charters, schedules, risk registers, lessons-learned logs, and after-action reports in accordance with federal contracting and VA documentation standards.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 4 years of project management experience, with demonstrated experience managing healthcare pilot programs, innovation initiatives, or similarly complex multi-stakeholder engagements. Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Public Health, Health Administration, Business Administration, Public Policy, or a related field required. Prior experience supporting federal agency clients, VA program offices, or federal healthcare environments strongly preferred; familiarity with VA organizational structure and mission is highly desirable. Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation; active clearance or prior federal suitability determination is a plus. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship; this position supports a federal government contract and is subject to applicable federal employment eligibility requirements. Demonstrated experience developing performance reports, briefing materials, or data packages for senior government leaders (SES-level or equivalent) and/or Congressional stakeholders.

Desired Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred. | - Experience with VA or federal health innovation offices (e.g., VHA Innovation Ecosystem, CMMI, CMTO, or equivalent) is a significant plus. | - Familiarity with federal performance management frameworks such as GPRAMA, OMB reporting requirements, or VA MISSION Act implementation. | - Experience using VA-approved collaboration and project tracking tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Teams, or equivalent federal-compliant platforms). | - Prior experience coordinating Congressional data calls, GAO engagements, or IG responses in a federal healthcare contracting context.

You will assess the information and knowledge-based needs of clinicians and Veterans, characterize and refine clinical processes, and lead the analysis, design, and continuous improvement of clinical decision support, clinical content, and standardized national workflows in the modernized electronic health record. You will translate complex clinical and operational problems into documented, defensible recommendations that VHA governance bodies and Tier 1 Subject Matter Experts can act on quickly.

Work on this program is organized under the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Analyses, decision support, and recommendations are delivered as Features within quarterly Planning Intervals, demonstrated to the government on a two-week cadence, and tracked in Jira and Jira Align.

The ideal candidate brings a clinical background, deep informatics expertise, strong facilitation skills, and the judgment to lead others and operate independently in a fast-moving, decision-driven environment.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Clinical Needs Assessment. Assess the information and knowledge-based needs of healthcare professionals and Veterans; characterize, evaluate, and refine clinical processes to improve safety, quality, and efficiency at the point of care.
  • Clinical Workflow Analysis and Standardization.   • Feature Delivery. Analyze government-provided problem statements and develop the lean business cases, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements needed to execute work prioritized in Planning Interval planning.
  • Agile Team Participation. Serve as a clinical subject matter expert on interdisciplinary agile teams; participate in daily stand-ups, iteration planning, PI planning, retrospectives, roadmap updates, and biweekly demonstration ceremonies, presenting both completed work and work in progress.
  • Decision Management Support. Intake, capture, and triage incoming clinical decisions through a standardized process; determine the appropriate decision-making authority based on established criteria; and create, maintain, and disseminate decision logs communicating Tier 1 SME decisions to stakeholders.
  • Governance and Consensus Building. Facilitate continuous exploration and iteration of standard configuration National Workflows, obtaining renewed consensus with Tier 1 SMEs, governing bodies, and VHA stakeholders; analyze emergent Courses of Action for adoption as standard workflow configurations or contingency plans.
  • Clinical Content Migration. Support migration of Design Decision Matrices (DDMs), Data Collection Workbooks (DCWs), and problem resolution artifacts, and integrate workflows into a VA National Standards of Practice Model in partnership with Oracle Health.
  • Value and Outcome Measurement. Perform value-based analysis of available healthcare data to assess and recommend how VA measures value delivered at the point of care; contribute to OKRs, KPIs, and leading indicators tied to safety, alignment to standard, timely access, cost reduction, automation, and provider and Veteran experience.
  • Risk and Quality Management. Identify, document, and track clinical and functional risks and issues; maintain risk registers; convey impacts to relevant VHA offices; and support quality assurance activities.
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Change Management. Engage clinical and operational stakeholders across VHACO, VISNs, and VAMCs; facilitate working sessions; and support communications and change management for informatics decisions and workflow changes.
  • Mentorship and Leadership. Provide direction, technical review, and mentorship to junior informaticists and analysts; may manage or lead the work of others.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience working in an Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including backlog management and delivery tracking in Jira and/or Jira Align.

Headquartered in Massachusetts with offices in New Jersey, Canada, Germany, Sweden, Switzerland and United Kingdom, Lantheus has been providing radiopharmaceutical solutions for nearly 70 years.

Through recent acquisitions, along with strategic partnerships across the life sciences ecosystem, we are accelerating our efforts to advance precision medicine and improve patient outcomes around the world.

Join us and be part of a company where your contributions make a real impact, because we know someone’s health is in our hands.

Role Summary:

The Customer Experience Director plays a critical role in ensuring Lantheus products are available to purchasing customers and patients. This role is responsible for a region of external purchasing customers to coordinate daily dose availability and supply in markets across their geography. The Director is also an integral part of a cross-functional team including Market Access, Strategic Accounts, Medical, Integrated Health Systems and other functions to identify business opportunities, address challenges and ensure availability and pull through of Lantheus products. Thriveworks is currently seeking provisionally licensed individuals pursuing Indiana Licensure as a LMHC in Indiana to provide telehealth sessions.

About the job
Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role
We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Approved by the board as a LMHCA

  • Must be seeking independent licensure and living in Indiana

  • A graduate of an approved 60-credit hour program

  • Graduate or Post-graduate work experience in a counseling setting treating depression and anxiety is required

  • Graduate or Post-graduate work experience independently conducting intakes and diagnosing (preferred) according to the current DSM-5 under a licensed supervisor.

Up to $51,700 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities. Full-time clinicians are eligible for health insurance, student loan repayment assistance, paid time off, and other employer-sponsored benefits.

We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.

Full-Stack AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Location: Remote (LATAM, Eastern Europe, Pakistan, India, South Africa Preferred)

About the Role

We are hiring a highly skilled Full-Stack AI Engineer to build, deploy, and scale AI-powered applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines full-stack software engineering with applied AI/ML expertise. You will work across backend systems, AI pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and frontend applications to bring AI features from prototype to production.

The ideal candidate is both technically strong and product-minded — someone who can move quickly, build scalable systems, and turn modern AI capabilities into reliable, user-friendly products.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and data teams to deliver AI-powered workflows, intelligent automation systems, chat experiences, analytics tools, and scalable machine learning infrastructure.

What You’ll Own

AI & LLM Integration

  • Deploy and integrate AI/ML models using OpenAI, Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks
    • Build scalable APIs for AI inference using FastAPI, Flask, or Node.js
    • Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or vector databases
    • Implement embeddings, semantic search, and AI-powered workflows
    • Optimize inference performance, latency, and cost efficiency

Full-Stack Application Development

  • Build frontend interfaces using React, Next.js, Vue, or modern JavaScript frameworks
    • Develop backend systems and APIs that connect AI models with business logic
    • Create user-facing AI features such as chatbots, copilots, dashboards, and automation tools
    • Ensure applications are responsive, secure, scalable, and production-ready
    • Build microservices and scalable backend architectures

Data Engineering & Pipelines

  • Develop ETL pipelines for ingesting, cleaning, transforming, and managing datasets
    • Automate preprocessing, data labeling, and workflow orchestration using Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster
    • Manage structured and unstructured datasets in cloud environments
    • Maintain reliable pipelines for model training, fine-tuning, and evaluation

Infrastructure, DevOps & MLOps

  • Containerize AI services using Docker and deploy applications using Kubernetes or cloud infrastructure
    • Build CI/CD pipelines for model deployments and application releases
    • Monitor model performance, drift, costs, and system reliability
    • Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Vertex AI, or SageMaker
    • Improve scalability, uptime, and infrastructure efficiency

Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Implement secure API authentication, access control, and rate limiting
    • Ensure AI systems comply with GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, or related compliance requirements
    • Maintain monitoring, logging, and observability for production systems
    • Troubleshoot production incidents and optimize system reliability

Collaboration & Product Development

  • Partner with product and data teams to define AI-powered product features
    • Translate AI prototypes into scalable production systems
    • Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, and architecture decisions
    • Maintain clear technical documentation and reproducible workflows

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You are both a strong software engineer and a hands-on AI builder
    • You enjoy shipping AI-powered features that solve real-world business problems
    • You are comfortable moving from prototype to production independently
    • You think critically about scalability, performance, cost, and usability
    • You stay current with rapidly evolving AI tools, frameworks, and infrastructure
    • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience with AI/ML exposure
    • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
    • Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
    • Experience deploying ML or LLM systems into production environments
    • Strong frontend experience with React, Next.js, or Vue
    • Experience building APIs and backend services
    • Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data platforms
    • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployments

Preferred Experience

  • Experience building AI-powered SaaS platforms or automation products
    • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, embeddings, and RAG systems
    • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search infrastructure
    • Experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI, or SageMaker
    • Knowledge of microservices, serverless architectures, and distributed systems
    • Experience optimizing inference cost and performance at scale

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Full-Stack AI Engineer’s day revolves around building production-ready AI systems and scalable applications. You will:
• Build and optimize AI-powered APIs and backend services
• Develop frontend interfaces for AI-driven experiences and workflows
• Maintain data pipelines and model integration systems
• Monitor production environments for performance, uptime, and cost efficiency
• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to prioritize and ship AI features
• Troubleshoot system bottlenecks and continuously improve scalability and reliability

In short: you help transform AI capabilities into scalable, production-grade products that drive real business impact.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Successful deployment of AI-powered features on schedule
    • Application uptime and infrastructure reliability maintained at high standards
    • Fast and stable inference performance for production endpoints
    • Reduction in manual workflows through AI automation
    • Strong adoption and usage of AI-powered product features
    • Scalable, maintainable, and cost-efficient system architecture

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (AI API + Full-Stack Integration Exercise)
    • Client Interview with Engineering Team

jobs.title: Developer Research Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: AI is changing how we solve problems with software.
jobs.description:
AI is changing how we solve problems with software. But some fundamentals remain. Whether the audience is an experienced developer, a newly minted builder, or a coding agent, there is often a gap between what a team assumes will work and what its users can understand, adopt, and use successfully.

MLH’s Developer Intelligence Network exists to bridge that gap. Using quantitative research, such as surveys, and qualitative research, such as interviews, we give technology companies insights that help them decide what to build, how to bring it to market, and where the developer experience needs to improve.

As our Developer Research Coordinator, you will help make that research possible. You will coordinate studies, manage our developer participant panel, and turn raw research material into organized, analysis-ready evidence. You’ll learn developer experience research by doing it while supporting companies ranging from startups to some of the world’s best-known technology brands.

Major League Hacking’s mission is to empower hackers. Each year, more than 100,000 young technologists and innovators around the world attend MLH events and join our community. MLH recently acquired DEV (dev.to), an online community for software developers. Together, our ecosystem supports millions of creators at every stage of their journey.

What you'll do:

  • Coordinate research studies, including participant invitations, scheduling, reminders, follow-ups, and other logistics from start to finish.

  • Support roughly one substantive study each month, typically involving 10–20 participants.

  • Keep overlapping stages of research moving, including recruiting for upcoming studies, coordinating active fieldwork, and processing recently completed research.

  • Clean transcripts, organize responses, tag useful quotes, and identify initial themes and patterns using established LLM-assisted workflows.

  • Review AI-generated outputs critically, verify themes against the source material, and flag conclusions that are inaccurate, overstated, or unsupported.

  • Produce an analysis-ready evidence pack for each study that the lead researcher can interpret and turn into final findings.

  • Run the developer panel day to day, including recruitment, onboarding, profile maintenance, participant matching, regular communication, and responding to participant questions.

  • Test onboarding experiences, documentation, code examples, and developer workflows, recording points of confusion or friction.

  • Support the quarterly MLH Census, including processing and conducting initial analysis across thousands of responses.

Requirements

  • Organized and reliable, with the ability to take ownership of a defined piece of work and keep it moving without being chased.

  • Able to manage research participant logistics from beginning to end.

  • Experienced using LLMs to work through qualitative material and able to evaluate their output critically rather than accepting it at face value.

  • Comfortable navigating developer tools, documentation, GitHub, and code well enough to understand what research participants are describing. Experience with a particular programming language or technology stack is not required.

  • Genuinely interested in developer tools, developer relations, technical education, online communities, or how people learn and build with technology.

  • A clear, proactive communicator who is comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

  • Available to overlap with UK working hours for a few hours each workday.

  • Bonus: Experience supporting research studies, surveys, interviews, focus groups, participant panels, or community programs

  • Bonus: Familiarity with MLH or DEV, community management experience, and comfort writing code or experimenting with developer tools

Compensation, Hours and Location

  • Weekly commitment: ~20 hours per week

  • Location: This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates globally who can overlap with UK working hours for at least a few hours each workday.

  • Compensation: The hourly rate will vary by location and will reflect the successful candidate’s experience and local market.

About Us

Evolphin is building the next generation of AI-powered media workflows for enterprise media teams managing large image and video libraries at scale, including environments with tens of millions of video assets and extremely large metadata and embedding footprints. Its platform adds a conversational AI layer for extracting intelligence from media, enabling powerful search, conversational discovery, and automation of media workflows through AskAI.

We're now pushing further into AI — building the next generation of intelligent, automation-first media management — and we're looking for people who want to help build that future from the ground up.

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer (5–8 years experience) who can take ownership of automation strategy and quality engineering for our AI-powered platform.

This role is primarily automation-focused, but will also require hands-on manual testing for new features, exploratory scenarios, AI output validation, and edge-case workflows. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, usability, performance, and scalability of our image and video automation workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving startup environments and enjoys building automation frameworks while staying close to product behavior through manual validation when needed.

Key Responsibilities

    • Design and own the end-to-end automation framework for web, API, and AI-driven features
    • Build API automation suites for our core automation workflows and integrations (Postman/Newman/RestAssured)

    • Ensure cross-browser compatibility for our design-heavy, canvas-based interfaces
    • Build performance testing suites to validate image/video processing throughput under load
    • Embed quality gates into our deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins)
    • Enable rapid, confident releases through automated testing at every stage
    • Create validation frameworks for non-deterministic ML results—balancing precision with creative flexibility
    • Partner with Product to define acceptance criteria for AI-driven features

    • Experience using LLMs (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to generate and refactor automation scripts
    • Ability to review, validate, and harden AI-generated test code (not blindly accept output)

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted test case generation and coverage analysis
    • Understanding of how to test AI-driven features (prompt testing, hallucination detection, cost optimizations, response validation)

Requirements

Good to Have

Benefits

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer (CPO)
jobs.excerpt: About Allia Health GroupAllia Health Group (AHG) is building a vertically integrated digital health platform — connecting compounding pharmacy, women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record, and an AI-and-data infrastructure layer into a single, coordinated patient experience.
jobs.description:
About Allia Health Group

Allia Health Group (AHG) is building a vertically integrated digital health platform — connecting compounding pharmacy, women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record, and an AI-and-data infrastructure layer into a single, coordinated patient experience. Our portfolio spans a 503A compounding pharmacy, two direct-to-consumer telehealth brands, and a provider-network EHR launching in 2026, all sharing a common goal: deliver personalized, outcomes-driven care beyond the limits of the traditional healthcare model.

We are assembling a senior leadership team to scale that platform. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define and lead the product strategy that turns a collection of strong businesses into one connected, durable healthcare system.

The Opportunity

This is AHG's first dedicated product executive. You will build and lead the product discipline across the company: what we build, for whom, why, and in what order — across every brand and surface. That means consumer direct-to-consumer subscription products in women's and men's telehealth, a provider-facing electronic health record launching this year, a clinical layer on top of a compounding pharmacy, and the shared patient platform that connects them. It is a deliberately broad mandate, and the breadth is the point.

The role is defined by a clear division of decision rights with our Chief Technology Officer.The CTO owns supply— architecture, engineering, data infrastructure, security, reliability, and delivery.The CPO owns demand— the user problems worth solving, the product strategy, the roadmap and its priority order, the discovery work that validates what gets built, and the outcomes the product is accountable for. The two roles are peers at the executive table, reporting to the CEO. Neither stacks under the other.

If you are the kind of product leader who is energized by building a function from the ground up — installing discovery, design, and product analytics as disciplines, growing a high-potential product team, and being personally accountable for whether real patients and providers actually use and value what we ship — this is a rare mandate.

AI is central to this role, not adjacent to it.Our CTO is investing heavily in AHG's AI and data platform — models, ML pipelines, automation, and safety infrastructure. We are looking for a CPO who is the demand-side counterpart to that investment: an AI-native product leader who decides which AI capabilities become real products for patients and clinicians, designs them to earn trust, and runs the product organization itself with AI woven into how the team discovers, prototypes, researches, and measures. You will not be selling AI to a skeptical company — you will be partnering with a technology org that is already all-in, and giving that capability a product and a purpose.

How the Role Works

AHG operates as a multi-entity platform.Each business unit is led by its own CEO who owns that unit's P&L. The CPO leads the product function as a shared, enterprise-wide capability that every business consumes — setting product standards, methods, and talent for the whole company, while owning end-to-end product for the shared patient platform and the new provider EHR directly.

  • Direct ownership:the shared cross-brand patient platform, the provider-network EHR product, the company's product discovery / design / research / analytics disciplines, and the product talent function.
  • Partnership ownership:business-unit roadmaps are set in close partnership with each BU's leadership. You are the executive who brings product rigor, evidence, and prioritization to those conversations — and the executive BU leaders escalate product and UX problems to.
  • Influence over authority:you will succeed here by being the most trusted voice on what's worth building, not by command. The mandate is real, but it is earned through evidence, outcomes, and partnership.
  • Stays with the CTO (not this role):the data warehouse and business intelligence, cloud and platform architecture, security and SOC 2, ERP and infrastructure vendors, engineering delivery, and the AI/ML platform and its safety infrastructure. The CPO sets the demand on these systems — what they must enable and why — while the CTO owns how they are built and run.

Key Responsibilities

Product strategy & portfolio prioritization

  • Own a product strategy for each business and for the portfolio — a distinct artifact from the technology roadmap that states, for each area: the user problem, the hypothesis, the outcome we are trying to move, and what we are deliberately not doing.
  • Prioritize across the portfolio through a product lens, not a bandwidth lens — deciding how finite product and engineering capacity is allocated across competing opportunities based on value, not on who asks loudest.
  • Champion a “connected system over isolated products” approach: a unified patient identity and experience across brands, rather than four disconnected silos.

Product discovery & evidence

  • Install product discovery as a standard: continuous customer and provider interviews, prototype and usability testing, and validated problem definition before significant build begins.
  • Require that major initiatives carry discovery artifacts — interview findings, an explicit hypothesis, and the metric that will tell us we were right or wrong — and make those artifacts drive what gets prioritized.

Design, user research & quality

  • Build the product design, user research, and design-system disciplines AHG needs — accessibility standards, interaction patterns, and a consistent quality bar across every brand and the EHR.
  • Be the executive accountable for whether the product is genuinely usable by the humans who use it — patients, providers, and pharmacists — and the advocate for the user when speed and shipping pressure compete with quality.

Outcomes & product analytics

  • Own outcome metrics, not output metrics: subscription retention and activation in the consumer telehealth brands, provider activation and retention on the EHR, medication adherence in the pharmacy programs, and patient experience (e.g., NPS) across the platform.
  • Stand up product analytics as a discipline distinct from business intelligence — event-level instrumentation, cohort and funnel analysis, and experimentation that lets a product manager find a drop-off and ship a fix against it.

Healthcare product leadership

  • EHR / provider experience:ensure the provider workflow is mapped, observed, and prototyped before production screens are built; reducing clinician cognitive burden is the single biggest determinant of adoption. Own the provider activation funnel end to end.
  • Clinical AI as product:set strategy for AI features that touch patients and clinicians — including an ambient documentation / scribing strategy for the EHR — partnering with the CTO, who owns the AI platform and safety infrastructure. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • Chronic-care platform layer:design the clinical-engagement layer (adherence, side-effect management, dose support) that turns medication fulfillment into a durable chronic-disease management experience.
  • Platform & interoperability:own the strategic product decision of whether AHG becomes one connected, multi-brand patient experience or stays a set of separate products — and ensure the shared platform and EHR are designed API-first, with a standards-based (HL7 / FHIR) encounter layer open enough to integrate external pharmacy, lab, imaging, and ambient-AI services rather than a closed system.
  • Regulated by design:partner with Compliance and Clinical so that product decisions respect HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, and clinical-safety requirements from the start, not as an afterthought.

An AI-first product organization

  • AI in the product:treat AI as a core design surface, not a bolt-on feature — set the strategy for the AI capabilities that touch patients and providers (triage and coaching assistants, ambient documentation, adherence and follow-up agents, decision support), partnering with the CTO who owns the underlying AI/ML platform and safety infrastructure.
  • Agentic AI with proportionate oversight:match the level of human oversight to the cost of a mistake — autonomous with audit logging for low-stakes, high-volume tasks; human-in-the-loop for medium-stakes; mandatory clinician review and accountability for anything liability-bearing. You decide what AI ships to users and hold the line when something isn't ready, even if it is technically deployable.
  • An AI-native team:run the product function itself with AI built into how the team works — AI-assisted user-research synthesis, rapid prototyping, competitive and market analysis, PRD and spec drafting, and product-analytics querying — so a small product team operates with outsized leverage. We want a leader who raises the bar on what AI-augmented product work looks like and hires people who think the same way.
  • Trustworthy by design:ensure AI features show their reasoning, expose confidence, and always leave a clear human override — in regulated healthcare this is a trust and liability standard, not a preference.

Team & cross-functional leadership

  • Build the product organization — hiring, leveling, and career paths for product managers, designers, and researchers, and developing existing high-potential product talent into senior leaders.
  • Partner deeply with the CTO and engineering to co-own delivery of the core platform, data products, and AI-enabled systems — product owns what and why; engineering owns how.
  • Serve as the bridge between the executive team and the product organization, translating company strategy into a roadmap and reporting on outcomes at the board level.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • A documented product strategy exists for each business and the portfolio, distinct from the tech roadmap, and is driving prioritization decisions.
  • Discovery, design, user research, and product analytics exist as functioning disciplines — with the right early hires in place — not as ad-hoc activities.
  • The provider EHR has a mapped clinical workflow, a decided ambient-AI strategy, and a measured provider activation funnel before — or at — launch.
  • Outcome metrics (retention, provider activation, adherence, NPS) are instrumented, visible to leadership, and owned by Product.
  • Business-unit leaders treat the CPO as the trusted partner they negotiate roadmap with and escalate product problems to.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 12+ years in product, with 5+ years in an executive product role (CPO, SVP/VP of Product, or equivalent) at a digital health, healthtech, regulated-SaaS, or enterprise-technology company.
  • A track record of building and scaling multi-product or platform-based ecosystems — not managing a single product line.
  • Direct experience in a regulated environment (healthcare strongly preferred; fintech or similarly regulated industries considered), including HIPAA, telehealth, FDA, or clinical-safety contexts.
  • Range across both of AHG's product worlds: consumer DTC subscription product (acquisition, activation, retention economics) AND provider- or clinical-facing product (clinical workflow, provider adoption). Deep expertise in one is required; credible, demonstrated range into the other is essential — this role cannot be filled by a single-surface specialist.
  • A proven partnership with a CTO/engineering leadership to bring complex products to market, with a clear, healthy demand-vs-supply working model.
  • Experience standing up product discovery, design, user research, and product analytics as disciplines — having built the function, not just inherited it.

jobs.title: Director, Data Center Program Controls
jobs.excerpt: About Montera: At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
About Montera:

At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Center Program Controls will lead the strategic development and execution of Montera’s program controls function supporting a national portfolio of hyperscale data center developments across Tier 1 markets in the United States and select markets in Canada. The program includes one to three facilities per campus, ranging from 50 MW to 300+ MW IT per site.

Reporting directly to the Chief Development Officer (CDO), this role is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing an integrated program controls framework that provides predictable outcomes across cost, schedule, risk, and commercial performance. The Director of Data Center Program Controls will establish standardized processes, systems, and performance metrics that enable informed decision-making and proactive management across the full project lifecycle—from early preconstruction and investment underwriting through project closeout.

This role requires a strategic mindset paired with hands-on leadership to support a total planned program of 1.5–2.5 GW IT capacity across multiple hyperscale campuses, ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across the development and delivery organization.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables:

Strategic Program Controls Leadership

  • Develop and scale a comprehensive, repeatable program controls framework encompassing preconstruction, cost, schedule, risk, change, and contract management.
  • Partner with the Chief Development Officer and executive leadership to align program controls strategy with corporate growth, capital deployment, and risk objectives.
  • Establish governance, reporting cadence, and escalation protocols to ensure clear visibility into program performance.

Preconstruction & Planning Management

  • Lead program-level preconstruction planning, including development of baseline budgets, schedules, and execution plans in support of investment decisions and project approvals.
  • Support site selection and due diligence efforts by evaluating cost, schedule, and risk drivers and ensuring alignment with program standards.
  • Standardize preconstruction deliverables, assumptions, and handoff requirements to downstream delivery teams.

Cost Management & Financial Controls

  • Develop and manage program-level cost management standards, including budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, and variance analysis.
  • Oversee cost reporting accuracy and consistency across all projects, ensuring alignment between development, delivery, and finance teams.
  • Implement change management processes to track, evaluate, and approve cost impacts while maintaining budget integrity.

Schedule Management

  • Establish and maintain program-level scheduling standards, including master schedules, milestone tracking, and critical path analysis.
  • Oversee integration of project schedules into a consolidated program view to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
  • Drive proactive schedule risk mitigation through trend analysis and corrective action planning.

KPI Development & Performance Reporting

  • Define, implement, and manage key performance indicators (KPIs), including both leading and lagging indicators, to measure cost, schedule, productivity, quality, and risk.
  • Develop executive-level dashboards and reporting tools that provide clear, actionable insights into program health.
  • Lead performance reviews with internal teams and external partners to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

Change & Contract Management

  • Establish standardized change management processes to evaluate scope, cost, and schedule impacts across the program.
  • Partner with legal, procurement, and delivery teams to support contract strategy, risk allocation, and compliance.
  • Monitor contract performance, claims exposure, and commercial risk across the portfolio.

Systems, Tools & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead selection, implementation, and optimization of program controls systems and tools (cost, schedule, reporting platforms).
  • Drive data quality, consistency, and integration across systems to support reliable analytics and decision-making.
  • Capture lessons learned and implement process improvements to enhance predictability and efficiency across future phases and projects.

Requirements

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in program controls, project controls, or project management within large-scale infrastructure, data center, or mission-critical environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing cost and schedule controls across multi-project, multi-market programs.
  • Strong expertise in preconstruction planning, cost management, scheduling, change management, and contract administration.
  • Proficiency in program controls and project management tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, Procore, and cost management systems.
  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams and influence across organizational boundaries.

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, including holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Recognition & Rewards: Annual bonus program to share in our success.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend plus phone allowance to help you stay connected.

At Montera, you’ll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.

Work Location: Remote/Hybrid

We believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable compensation range for this role is $200,000 - $260,000.
