jobs.excerpt: Why Patients Need YouThe Inflammation and Immunology Dedicated Care Coordinator (DCC) is a non-promotional, field-based role that supports patients’ access to PDPA and VFM products when prescribed by a licensed healthcare provider.
jobs.description:
Why Patients Need You

The Inflammation and Immunology Dedicated Care Coordinator (DCC) is a non-promotional, field-based role that supports patients’ access to PDPA and VFM products when prescribed by a licensed healthcare provider. The DCC owns the continual management and progression of the patient journey — from HUB enrollment through post-fill follow-up — working directly with patients, providers, payers, HUB partners, and third-party vendors. It is a dual patient- and HCP-facing role spanning a patient journey, and the colleague in this role carries 100% ownership of every case in their assigned geography.

What You Will Achieve

The DCC is a subject-matter expert on reimbursement, access, and coverage issues that can educate patients/caregivers and healthcare providers on matters relating to reimbursement, access, and coverage. The DCC will serve as the primary point of contact for patients/caregivers and healthcare providers regarding the status of their request for reimbursement support and access assistance and will also provide updates to patients/caregivers and healthcare providers on their status as appropriate. The DCC holds end-to-end case ownership: benefits investigation and verification, prior authorization and appeals support, appointment and baseline assessment coordination, Interim Care and voucher administration, copay support, prescription triage, and scheduled post-fill follow-up.

How You Will Achieve It

Case Ownership and the Patient Journey

  • Own 100% of assigned cases and drive the continual management and progression of the patient journey, from HUB enrollment through post-fill follow-up

  • Be the central point-of-contact for patients/caregivers and HCP providers regarding the status of their request for reimbursement and access support related to a patient case.

  • Answer questions from patients/caregivers relating to access and coverage

  • Maintain a clear understanding of the patient access journey and requirements at each stage of the process, as well as the role played by patients/caregivers and HCP providers in the process

  • Support access with HCPs and opted-in patients/caregivers who have been prescribed a PDPA OR VFM product

Benefits Investigation and Financial Navigation

  • Conduct the Summary of Benefits (SOB) discussion required for every HUB-enrolled patient, reviewing both the product benefit structure, any associated cost and the baseline appointments for VFM

  • Obtain all missing information on the Patient Enrollment Form (PEF) and verify the testing, voucher, and Interim Care options selected by the HCP office

  • Walk the patient through out-of-pocket cost, deductibles, copay options, and the reimbursement program, including the impact of maximizers and accumulators

  • Verify coverage for the product and for required baseline tests across both PBM and major medical insurance for VFM

  • Oversee the entire prior authorization process, including submission and verification with both the patient and the provider

  • Conduct benefit investigation and verification (BI/BV) calls directly with payers and patients for patients with 3rd party restrictions

  • Confirm and communicate product coverage, cost, prior authorization and appeal requirements, Interim Care program PA and Appeal deadlines, and baseline assessment tests to HCP and patient

Appointment and Assessment Coordination

  • Schedule, reschedule and confirm patient appointments in coordination with the patient, the provider, and the vendor

  • Secure the appropriate confirmation communication back from the provider (CFT)

  • Coordinate compliantly with IQVIA/MDX on patient assessment tests — confirm tests are completed and reschedule where needed

Program and Copay Administration

  • Once IC is approved, manage all Interim Care (IC) program administrative requirements and deadlines with the provider and the patient, including Extended Interim Care programs

  • Confirm voucher need and eligibility with the provider and patient, and triage the voucher for shipment to the patient

  • Maintain Copay portal access and help approved commercial patients secure a copay card

  • Own copay eligibility attestation responsibility

  • Follow up with the patient post-fill to confirm the copay card is functioning correctly

Prescription Triage, Fulfillment, and Ongoing Follow-Up

  • Triage the voucher, paid prescription, and/or Interim Care fill within Polaris

  • Contact the patient at 10 days and again at 45 days post-prescription, confirming that no logistical or financial questions remain outstanding

Case and Systems Ownership

  • Manage and update various case types in Polaris, using its texting, faxing, and prescription triage capabilities

  • View and interpret prior authorization, appeal, and PEF documentation for accuracy

  • Share and manage cases with HUB partners across all patient journeys

  • Coordinate as appropriate with other Pfizer colleagues and Patient Support Program/HUB employees, via tasks and secure messages to requests for action, to help resolve problems with individual patient cases

  • Maintain case comments as a real-time account of the patient journey, including a recap of every call made to the HCP and the patient

  • Use the Kite works encrypted email system for correspondence with patients and providers

  • Manage the Docusign process with patients to obtain required consents

  • Develop an organized, concise, and compliant way to manage assigned patient cases within established time frames

Compliance, Safety Reporting, and Communication

  • Report adverse events (AEs) in accordance with company requirements — AE reporting volume is elevated in this role, patient contact is more frequent and spans the entire patient journey

  • Operate within the tighter content controls and system permissions that apply to this role

  • Compliantly communicate the access landscape and options to patients/caregivers and HCPs

  • Link the patient access support to meet patient needs, using Brand RC-approved materials

  • Conduct yourself with the utmost discretion and confidentiality

  • Adhere to strict company compliance guidelines and procedures

  • Work and lead cross-functionally with internal and external colleagues, compliantly, to improve the patient access journey

  • Effectively link customer insights to the offerings and approved resources to address patient access barriers

  • Build trust through compliant follow-up and knowledge of the access journey

  • Demonstrate excellence in responsible business communication, both written and spoken

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • B.S. or B.A. Degree 8+ years of pharmaceutical (or related) experience in customer-facing roles/functions.

  • 6 months minimum as a FRM, PAC, FAS or similar experience in access and Reimbursement and working with Polaris CRM System.

  • Working proficiency in Polaris, including case management and documentation, prescription triage, and interpretation of PA, appeal, and PEF documentation

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate directly with patients, with providers, and with cross-functional colleagues

  • Experience conducting benefit investigation and verification directly with payers, and working knowledge of prior authorization and appeals processes

  • Working knowledge of copay programs, copay maximizers and accumulators, vouchers, and free or interim care programs

  • Ability to own a high volume of concurrent cases across a patient journey that could average approximately 20 days, with disciplined documentation and follow-through

  • Ability to meet adverse event reporting obligations in a role with frequent, direct patient contact

  • Strong understanding of Reimbursement, Government Payment Systems, Specialty Pharmacy Networks, Co-Pay Assistance Programs, and knowledge of the Specialty Medication area.

  • Appropriate and compliant communication and collaboration with cross-functional field-based colleagues (Sales, Medical, FRM, PCA/SAS, KAD, Government Relations) to ensure optimal and appropriate patient access in both in-patient and out-patient accounts.

  • Alignment with HQ stakeholders to ensure appropriate understanding of, and support for patient access (e.g., Brand and Customer Marketing teams and PCA/SAS teams).

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in a Patient and/or customer facing role requiring access and reimbursement education.

  • Experience working with a HUB.

  • Experience with Kite works or a comparable encrypted email platform, Docusign, and copay portal administration

  • Experience coordinating with third-party vendors on patient assessment, testing, or specialty pharmacy logistics (e.g., IQVIA/MDX, Sonexus)

  • Experience supporting Interim Care, free goods, or bridge programs

  • Experience with both pharmacy benefit (PBM) and major medical benefit coverage pathways

Knowledge & Skill Sets Desired:

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Exceptional relationship building skills, especially with elderly age groups

  • Trust

  • Integrity

  • Empathy

  • Patience

  • Deliver meaningful & concise presentations

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Exceptional critical thinking skills, ability to understand complex processes and effectively communicate to diverse community of patients

  • Outstanding collaboration and networking abilities

  • Ability to work in a team environment

  • Understanding of Specialty Pharmaceuticals and Patient Journeys

  • Adherence to Regulatory and Compliance Standards

  • Flexibility to work across different time zones if needed

Other Job Details

  • Work Location Assignment: Remote colleagues from home 5 days a week or are field-based colleagues that are not affiliated with a Pfizer site.

  • Ability to travel – Approximately 10% to 20%

  • Time Zone: Central time zone.

  • Eligible for Relocation Package – NO

  • LAST DAY TO APPLY - 9/18/2026

jobs.excerpt: About MathspaceMathspace is a cutting-edge eLearning platform delivering enriching, personalised mathematics content to thousands of schools worldwide.
jobs.description:
About Mathspace

Mathspace is a cutting-edge eLearning platform delivering enriching, personalised mathematics content to thousands of schools worldwide. Students receive step-by-step feedback and guidance, and our interactive content adapts to each learner’s proficiency while providing educators with data-driven insights to guide student growth. Mathspace is an online mathematics program used by students from primary school through higher education , with a mission to transform the traditional one-size-fits-all math textbook into an engaging, adaptive learning journey.

About the Role

We are looking for an IB Curriculum Content Project Manager to lead the creation and refinement of our International Baccalaureate (IB) mathematics textbooks for both the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). In this 12-month contract role (fully remote), you will leverage your deep understanding of the IB curriculum to ensure our content is pedagogically sound, fully aligned with IB standards, and of the highest quality. You will project manage the end-to-end content development process, coordinating a team of writers and editors, planning content delivery, performing detailed reviews, and continually improving our workflow with the latest tech and AI tools.

This role is ideal for an experienced IB educator or curriculum developer who is also tech-savvy. You will play a critical part in shaping world-class IB math resources that empower teachers and students globally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Content Development: Oversee the end-to-end creation of IB MYP & DP mathematics textbook content, from initial planning through final publication. Manage project timelines, set milestones, and ensure the content development stays on track.
  • Curriculum Alignment: Ensure all lessons, examples, and practice questions are tightly aligned with IB curriculum requirements and reflect the depth and breadth of the IB MYP and DP syllabi. The goal is to cover all required topics with appropriate rigor and IB-specific approaches (e.g. inquiry-based learning, real-world contexts).
  • Content Review & Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews of content produced by the team (including lessons, questions, solutions, and explanatory materials). Provide detailed, specific feedback to authors on how to improve clarity, pedagogical effectiveness, and alignment. Your review comments will guide the internal team in making edits to meet our high standards of accuracy, clarity, and IB-style educational quality.
  • Team Coordination: Work closely with a team of content developers, educators, and editors. Facilitate collaboration and communication across the team, ensuring everyone understands the project goals and quality expectations. Mentor content writers in best practices for IB curriculum design.
  • Process Improvement & AI Integration: Continuously refine our content development and review processes to improve efficiency and quality. Be proactive in leveraging technology and AI tools (e.g. content generation and analysis tools) to aid in creating and reviewing materials. For example, use AI to help generate draft questions or check alignment, and integrate new tools to streamline workflows. Being comfortable with the latest ed-tech and AI tools is a must for maximizing productivity.
  • Final Quality Ownership: Before content is released, ensure that each unit/chapter meets a “world-class” quality standard: fact-checked, pedagogically sound, engaging for students, and polished in language and presentation. Ultimately, you are the guardian of quality for our IB math textbooks, ensuring that Mathspace’s IB offerings can serve as comprehensive stand-alone resources for schools .

Requirements

  • IB Curriculum Expertise: Extensive knowledge of the IB mathematics curriculum for MYP and DP. Ideally, at least a few years of experience teaching IB MYP and/or DP Mathematics, or experience in developing IB-aligned curriculum materials. You should be intimately familiar with IB objectives, assessment criteria, and the style of IB math problems.
  • Content Development Experience: Strong background in educational content creation – for example, writing or editing math textbook chapters, lesson plans, or exam-style questions. You understand how to scaffold concepts and design practice problems that build understanding.
  • Project Management Skills: Excellent organisational and project management abilities. Experience leading projects or teams in an education or publishing context is highly valued (e.g. managing a curriculum writing project or publishing a textbook). You can break down large tasks, meet deadlines, and coordinate others’ work effectively.
  • Tech Savvy & AI Proficiency: High comfort with technology and quick to adapt to new tools. Willingness to use and experiment with modern AI tools to enhance productivity and content quality is essential. You don’t need to be a programmer, but you should be eager to utilise software to work smarter. Experience with tools like LaTeX or other math authoring software is also beneficial .
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills – especially in writing clear, constructive feedback. Ability to work collaboratively in a remote team, coordinate meetings or discussions across time zones, and share knowledge with colleagues. You can articulate what makes good educational content and guide others to achieve it.
  • Detail Orientation and Quality Focus: Meticulous attention to detail when it comes to academic accuracy, formatting, and consistency. A passion for maintaining high quality standards. You care about the student learning experience and will insist on clarity and correctness in every piece of content.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Educational Publishing Experience: Prior experience in a curriculum publishing role or as an editor for math educational content. Familiarity with the processes of textbook publishing, such as peer review, copyediting, and layout considerations.
  • Assessment and Exam Insight: Experience writing or grading mathematics exams (for IB or other curricula) can be helpful, as it gives insight into exam-style question quality and common student pitfalls .
  • Coding/Tools: Basic experience with programming or data tools (e.g. Python or SQL) isn’t required but could be useful in working with our system or analysing content usage data . Similarly, experience using LaTeX for mathematical content formatting is an advantage.

Benefits

  • Remote Work & Flexibility: This role is fully remote – work from home with flexible hours. We value work-life balance and can accommodate flexible arrangements .
  • Collaborative, Impactful Culture: Join a relaxed, friendly team environment where your contributions directly impact teachers and students across the world . We foster creativity and teamwork, with the shared goal of improving math education globally.
  • Professional Growth: You’ll be at the forefront of integrating AI and innovative practices in education. This is an opportunity to lead a high-profile project and further develop leadership skills in curriculum development.
  • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a mission to deliver better learning experiences. Your work will help shape a comprehensive IB math resource used by schools internationally, truly making a difference in classrooms.

If you are passionate about the IB curriculum and excited about harnessing technology to create outstanding educational content, we’d love to hear from you. Come help us shape the future of IB mathematics learning with Mathspace!

Category: IT Services

Location: Jacksonville Florida United States


Job Summary/Job Purpose

The Senior Cloud Solution Architect owns the design and technical direction of complex, cross-functional systems across the Client’s cloud and on-prem environments. This role bridges business requirements and technical execution, translating strategic objectives into scalable, secure, and maintainable architectures. Success is demonstrated through sound architectural decisions, consistent technical standards, and solutions that balance cost, performance, security, and long-term maintainability. This position works closely with Engineering, Product , Operations, and Technology leadership to ensure new and existing systems align with organizational strategy and technical governance. Knowledge of training and compliance with LMS is a Big plus.

Job Duties / Essential Functions

Architecture Strategy and Technical Leadership

  • Advise on the development and execution of Client's cloud and infrastructure architecture strategy in partnership with Engineering and organizational leadership.
  • Serve as the key technical advisor and subject-matter expert for solution architecture across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Provide technical leadership for cross-functional discovery, design, and implementation efforts.
  • Translate business challenges and requirements into practical technical architectures and roadmaps.
  • Present architectural decisions, tradeoffs, and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Monitor developments in cloud platforms, architectural patterns, security practices, and vendor capabilities.

SoSolution Design and Delivery

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture and technical design of applications, platforms, integrations, and infrastructure from concept through production.
  • Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference designs, and technical standards across teams.
  • Evaluate and recommend platforms, services, hosting models, and build-versus-buy options based on scalability, security, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
  • Design and document data flows, system integrations, APIs, and service boundaries across distributed systems.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide design guidance throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Own multi-cloud and hybrid architecture decisions, including workload placement, migration strategy, and cost optimization.

Governance, Standards, and Risk Management

  • Define and maintain architectural governance standards, including security, compliance, scalability, and resiliency requirements.
  • Evaluate the technical, security, and compliance risks of proposed architectures and integrations.
  • Maintain architecture documentation, decision records, and reference diagrams for approved systems.
  • Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure designs meet regulatory and organizational requirements.
  • Identify architectural risk, technical debt, and single points of failure, and recommend remediation plans.

Collaboration and Enablement

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure implementations align with approved architecture and design standards.
  • Mentor engineers and technical staff in architectural principles, cloud design patterns, and best practices.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with business stakeholders to scope new initiatives.
  • Collaborate with vendors, strategic partners, and external consultants on technical requirements and implementation decisions.
  • Promote shared ownership, effective documentation, and knowledge transfer across the technology organization.
  • Communicate architectural decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support cost optimization initiatives across cloud environments, including resource rightsizing and reserved capacity planning.
  • Support incident response and root-cause analysis for architecture-level failures.
  • Provide backup technical oversight for critical infrastructure and platform decisions.
  • Assist with due diligence and technical assessment of new vendors, acquisitions, or third-party platforms.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Delivery Expectations

  • Deliver architecture designs and documentation that translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Lead technical discovery and proof-of-concept efforts for new initiatives.
  • Present architectural findings and recommendations to stakeholders and decision makers in clear business language.
  • Deliver secure, scalable, and well-documented architectures.
  • Define key architectural and operational metrics, and track performance against them.
  • Use metrics and lessons learned to guide continuous improvement of architectural standards and practices.

What Success Looks Like

  • Establishes clear architectural direction and prioritizes high-value technical investments.
  • Delivers secure, scalable, and cost-effective architectures with measurable business value.
  • Maintains architectural governance while supporting delivery timelines.
  • Leads initiatives from discovery through design, implementation, and adoption.
  • Provides dependable technical guidance for critical systems and infrastructure decisions.
  • Builds trusted partnerships across departments and with external vendors.
  • Communicates technical concepts, risks, and recommendations in clear business terms.
  • Improves architectural practices, system reliability, documentation, and shared technical knowledge.
  • Operates effectively within Agile, security, compliance, and governance standards.

Qualifications

Required

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or systems architecture, including 5+ years in a dedicated architecture role.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering cloud-native or hybrid architectures at scale.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, security architecture, cost governance, and migration strategy.
  • Experience communicating technical decisions to both engineering teams and business stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience with multi-cloud environments (AWS and Azure).
  • Experience with DevOps with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, SST) and CI/CD pipeline design.
  • Experience in SecOps around regulated industries (healthcare, finance, or similar) with HIPAA, GDPR, or SOC 2 considerations.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS).
  • Experience architecting applications with React and Next.js.
  • Experience designing serverless architectures using AWS Lambda.

About Wider Circle

Wider Circle is a mission-driven healthcare organization working to improve health outcomes for older adults and complex populations by addressing social and clinical barriers to care. Through trusted relationships and community-based support, we partner with health plans and local organizations to help members navigate healthcare, stay engaged in care, and live healthier lives.

We are launching a permanent clinical program that integrates physicians, care navigators, and community support teams to create a coordinated, human approach to care — and we're looking for a physician leader to help build it.

About the Role

We are seeking a multi-state licensed physician to serve as our Telehealth Physician Lead, providing clinical oversight, quality assurance, and hands-on leadership for our growing telehealth care program. Reporting to the VP of Care Delivery, you will own clinical execution and iteration — conducting virtual visits, leading, training and overseeing a team of physicians, and continuously refining workflows to ensure high-quality, coordinated care.

This is a hybrid clinical-leadership role: part practicing telehealth physician, part program builder. You'll see patients yourself, facilitate community-based appointments, and set the standard for how our clinical team operates. After initial visits, ongoing support is provided by a care team including Community Health Workers and Licensed Clinical Social Workers, allowing clinicians to focus on clinical guidance rather than longitudinal case management.

This role is ideal for physicians interested in innovative care delivery, telehealth, community health, and population health models that extend beyond traditional office-based practice.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct initial telehealth visits with enrolled members, assessing medical needs, care gaps, and barriers to accessing care
  • Build and develop a high-performing clinical team, providing mentorship and professional development to foster long-term growth and leadership within the organization
  • Establish clear clinical plans and care priorities, and collaborate with the care team for smooth handoffs
  • Clinical oversight and QA: Audit clinical documentation to ensure compliance with community health billing and program requirements, and that social-determinants sequencing is logical and actionable
  • Physician training and management: Serve as the primary clinical point of contact for our physician team — onboard new clinicians, deliver feedback, lead re-training, and ensure alignment with company values
  • Appointment and workflow management: Help structure scheduling, intake, SMA logistics, and clinical workflows to scale efficiently across markets
  • Policy iteration: Identify broken processes in the field and rapidly iterate on clinical policies, intake forms, and care plan templates
  • Metric stewardship: Track and report on key clinical KPIs including ER diversion rates, care gap closures, and SDoH resolution
  • Partner with Area Managers and LCSWs to bridge medical providers and Community Health Workers, ensuring the team operates as a unified care engine
  • Provide clinical insight to refine program workflows as we scale

Requirements

What You Bring

Build the team. Create the playbook. Scale the customer revenue engine.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Sales & Customer Success to lead that transformation across our customer segments.

The Opportunity

This is not a role where you inherit a fully built sales and customer success machine.

You’ll have the opportunity to help build it.

You’ll lead and develop a growing team responsible for customer retention, expansion, and new revenue while creating the processes, playbooks, metrics, and management structure required to operate effectively at scale.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. One day you may be designing the customer segmentation model or renewal process; the next, you may be coaching a rep through an expansion opportunity, reviewing an at-risk account, or helping close a deal.

You’ll have meaningful ownership over how we serve and grow our SMB and Mid-Market customers—and the opportunity to build a function that can scale with the business.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Build a high-performing SMB and Mid-Market Sales & Customer Success organization with clear roles, expectations, KPIs, and accountability.
  • Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop a strong team of Account Managers and Customer Success professionals.
  • Create scalable customer journeys and playbooks across onboarding, adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion.
  • Improve Net Revenue Retention by reducing preventable churn and creating a consistent expansion motion across the customer base.
  • Establish clear forecasting and pipeline management for renewals, upsells, cross-sells, and other customer revenue opportunities.
  • Introduce a scalable operating model that balances high-touch engagement for strategic customers with efficient 1-to-many programs for SMB customers.
  • Build better visibility into customer health, revenue risk, and expansion potential.
  • Create a disciplined, accountable culture where the team understands what great performance looks like and has the coaching and tools to achieve it.

What You’ll Do

Key Responsibilities

Lead, Build & Develop the Team

  • Lead the SMB and Mid-Market Sales & Customer Success teams, establishing clear expectations, responsibilities, and performance standards.
  • Own recruiting and hiring as the organization grows.
  • Build structured onboarding and enablement programs that help new team members ramp quickly.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, account reviews, and call coaching.
  • Develop the team’s capabilities in consultative selling, negotiation, customer relationship management, retention, and expansion.
  • Establish clear individual and team KPIs and create a strong culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Identify performance gaps early and coach team members toward stronger outcomes.

Build the Customer Success Operating Model

  • Design and document scalable playbooks for onboarding, adoption, account management, renewal, expansion, and churn prevention.
  • Develop differentiated engagement models for SMB and Mid-Market customers based on customer value, complexity, opportunity, and risk.
  • Build repeatable 1-to-many programs that allow the team to effectively support a high-volume customer base.
  • Establish customer health scoring and early-warning indicators for churn and expansion opportunities.
  • Define clear escalation paths and operating processes across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Implementation, Product, and Payments.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve team productivity.

Drive Retention & Expansion

  • Own the team’s performance against Net Revenue Retention, renewal, churn, and expansion targets.
  • Establish a consistent renewal process that creates visibility well in advance of contract expiration.
  • Build and standardize upsell and cross-sell motions across the customer base.
  • Coach the team on identifying customer needs, creating value-based expansion opportunities, and successfully navigating commercial conversations.
  • Partner with internal teams to address customer risks before they become churn events.
  • Step into strategic or complex customer conversations when leadership involvement can materially improve the outcome.

Create Revenue Visibility & Accountability

  • Build accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasting for renewals, expansion, and customer revenue.
  • Establish pipeline standards and operating rhythms that give leadership a clear view of expected performance.
  • Track and analyze performance metrics across the customer lifecycle.
  • Use product usage, customer engagement, commercial, and CRM data to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Ensure CRM and Customer Success systems accurately reflect account activity, pipeline, customer health, and next steps.
  • Provide leadership with clear insights into performance, trends, risks, and opportunities.

You’ll Thrive Here If...

  • You enjoy building structure where it doesn’t yet exist.
  • You believe strong leadership means both setting a clear standard and actively coaching people toward it.
  • You like working close to customers and are comfortable getting involved when an important account or opportunity needs help.

  • Analizar, monitorizar y gestionar eventos e incidentes de seguridad relacionados con el tráfico web, la navegación corporativa y los sistemas de acceso a Internet.
  • Realizar tareas de troubleshooting avanzado para la resolución de incidencias complejas, identificando causas raíz e implementando medidas correctivas y preventivas.
  • Evaluar, diseñar e implementar cambios en configuraciones, políticas de filtrado y controles de seguridad, garantizando el equilibrio entre protección, rendimiento y necesidades de negocio.
  • Participar en el estudio y validación de nuevas integraciones y funcionalidades de las plataformas de seguridad, contribuyendo a la evolución tecnológica de los servicios gestionados.

  • Mantener actualizados los componentes de seguridad, revisando continuamente nuevas funcionalidades, vulnerabilidades emergentes y mejores prácticas del sector.
  • Participar en revisiones periódicas de políticas de seguridad para garantizar su alineación con los requisitos de negocio, normativos y de ciberseguridad.
  • Apoyar procesos de auditoría, cumplimiento y mejora continua relacionados con la protección perimetral y la seguridad del tráfico web.

  • Experiencia en administración y gestión de soluciones de firewall y controles de seguridad perimetral.
  • Capacidad analítica para la investigación, diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias complejas en entornos de producción.
  • Habilidad para trabajar de forma organizada, gestionar múltiples tareas simultáneamente y adaptarse a entornos tecnológicos cambiantes.

  • Experiencia en soluciones de protección de aplicaciones web y tecnologías Imperva.
  • Formación académica o certificaciones acreditables en ciberseguridad, seguridad de redes o disciplinas relacionadas.
  • Experiencia previa en entornos SOC, servicios gestionados de seguridad (MSSP) o centros de operaciones de ciberseguridad.

jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

jobs.description:
Summary

The SEC Reporting Consultant serves as an accounting expert and applies accounting acumen to customers on a project basis, providing customer project management, XBRL data modeling, mapping, tagging, and review of customer XBRL projects in compliance with quality and customer satisfaction standards. We are committed to providing comprehensive training of XBRL principles and equipping you with the proficiency to effectively utilize the Workiva platform in facilitating our clients' XBRL filings.

What You’ll Do

  • Model the XBRL Mapping, utilizing the applicable Taxonomy, selecting the appropriate line item concepts, axis, and members

  • Interpret guidance from the applicable taxonomy to determine accuracy of tag choice and ensure that extensions follow the relative intent of the taxonomy

  • Tag the values in the companies’ Financial Statements and Notes, Financial Statement Schedules, and other information requiring tagging with the concepts identified

  • Determine whether values are stated at a point in time (Balance Sheet), or over a period of time (P&L), and whether monetary values represent debits or credits.

  • Master the intricacies of financial reporting, spanning a range of vital components including stock-based compensation, fair value assessment, derivatives, pensions, income taxes, inventory valuation, investments, property, plant and equipment, comprehensive income, leases, revenue recognition, and the latest accounting standards. Your expertise will illuminate our financial landscape, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and transparency in every facet of reporting.

  • Maintain knowledge of taxonomies, SEC regulations, emerging XBRL requirements, and accounting

  • Map the Financial Statements and Notes, and Financial Statement Schedules to the appropriate XBRL taxonomy (GAAP, IFRS)

  • Review the accounting policies, statements, notes, and schedules, and gain an understanding of the amounts presented to identify the related accounting standards concepts in the appropriate taxonomy

  • Understand the industry accounting disclosures specific to company customers

  • Maintain knowledge of taxonomies, regulations, and accounting standards' changes

  • Stay current with industry trends, updates on accounting standards and regulatory requirements, identifying and apply new skills

  • Collaborate with other internal teams, including Product Development, Sales, Marketing, and Learning & Development, to advance company training and standardize changes

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field

  • 2+ years of experience, experience working in a CPA firm or financial reporting environment preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CIA certification

  • Undergraduate Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field

  • Proven track record of delivering projects on time, on budget, and to a high-quality standard

  • Successful experience working cooperatively and collaboratively in a team environment

  • Sound knowledge of and competency with SEC and SEDAR reporting requirements

  • Strong U.S. GAAP (or other accounting standards where applicable) acumen and understanding of financial reporting

  • Understand and interpret taxonomy structure

  • Demonstrated capacity for self-motivated initiation, execution, and consistent follow-through

  • Ability to allow for contingencies, prioritize multiple and potentially overlapping customer requirements, and plan filing dates

  • Willingness to travel, less than 10% travel expected for team and corporate meetings, contributing to building strong relationships and representing the company's interests

Travel Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Minimal travel for internal meetings

  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office

Workiva will not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $68,000.00 - $110,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

We are seeking an experienced and innovative attorney with expertise and a strong track record of enabling product development and negotiating strategic commercial partnerships in the financial services and/or healthcare fields. The Associate General Counsel, Product and Growth is responsible for our legal strategy and enabling the company’s compliant execution of its product and growth strategies as we develop new products and services, key strategic commercial partnerships, and other areas of innovation and growth. This role will provide strategic guidance to develop and bring to market new products and services ensuring regulatory compliance, IP protection, and risk mitigation. In doing so, this role will navigate multiple regulatory frameworks and apply them in new or novel settings. This role will be a key partner in enabling the execution of HealthEquity’s key strategic initiatives and future growth in a compliant and customer-focused manner. You will serve as a trusted advisor to enable the company to navigate innovative product and service offerings and partnerships. As part of a collaborative team, you will deliver practical, business-oriented legal guidance to apply applicable laws, regulations, policies, and best practices to new products and services. You will partner with business leaders in the technology, product, service delivery and marketing teams to anticipate needs, craft agile governance frameworks, and align risk management with growth priorities. You will constantly address unique legal issues at the intersection of employee benefits, healthcare, and financial services. In doing so, you will find that the Legal Department is a key enabler and strategic partner in all aspects of HealthEquity’s growth.

What you’ll be doing

Essential Management Responsibilities:

  • Manages and carries out the personnel actions for direct reports, including but not limited to hiring and scheduling; training and evaluating; coaching and managing performance; making salary, merit, or other compensation recommendations for team of direct reports; and making recommendations and/or taking corrective or disciplinary action as appropriate.

Essential Duties and Primary Responsibilities:

  • Advise on complex legal and regulatory issues relating to consumer facing products and services
  • Review, draft and negotiate agreements and provisions relating to strategic commercial partnerships, and new products and services.
  • Assess legal risk associated with new products and services, align with internal stakeholders quickly, recommend safeguards, and guide business teams toward compliance and practical solutions
  • Embed Legal team partnership through the new product development lifecycle
  • Partner and collaborate with other internal and external counsel and various teams to understand regulatory, product, engineering, design and operational implications of new products and services
  • Mature and maintain an intellectual property management program and partner with the People and Product teams in developing innovative frameworks for IP development
  • Translate new and emerging laws into actionable, effective legal guidance
  • Identify and support process improvements to promote agility in legal and related business operations

What you will need to be successful

Education and Experience:

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school with an active license to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction
  • 10+ years of experience advising on product development in regulated industries at a top law firm or with a combination of applicable in-house legal work
  • Experience advising all levels of management, including C-suite executives, and board members on new product development and strategic partnerships with clear presentation of risks, potential impacts, solutions and risk management strategies
  • Experience advising on new products and services within the banking/finance and healthcare industries
  • Experience in regulated industries and data privacy regulatory compliance
  • Experience in marketplaces

Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to synthesize complex legal issues, issue spot, engage appropriate subject matter expertise and provide practical risk management advice
  • Ability to learn new regulatory regimes quickly and apply practical guidance for the team
  • Ability to identify solutions and drive the business forward
  • Ideal candidate will have expertise in UDAP, financial regulations, ERISA welfare benefit plans, HSAs and other consumer directed benefits, GLBA and HIPAA
  • Familiarity with evolving federal and state regulations related to HSAs and consumer-directed benefits
  • Team attitude that no job is too big or too small
  • Thrives in a “roll-up your sleeves and own the outcome” environment
  • Ability to strike sensible and practical balance between legal risks and the need to do business
  • Adept at working in a fast-paced, high activity environment with smart and creative people
  • Strong ability to influence, provide point of view, and to listen
  • Ability to deliver strategic insights to compliance teams and shape governance structures for new products
  • Capacity to quickly understand complex business models and technology trends, aligning legal requirements and anticipated regulations with business strategy to “Future proof” business operations
  • Growth mindset with an openness to new ideas, diverse perspectives, and unconventional solutions
  • Strong ability to influence, provide point of view, and to listen
  • Excellent verbal and interpersonal communication skills and ability to work effectively work with various departments and levels within HealthEquity (including senior management)
  • Excellent judgment, attention to detail, and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information
  • Ability to handle ambiguity, juggle many matters at once, and quickly shift from one situation or task to another
  • Solution oriented and talent for thinking outside of the box in confronting new issues and pursuing novel approaches to old problems

Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school with an active license to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

Physical/Mental Requirements and Demands:

  • Work requires normal range of hearing, vision and verbal communication skills, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Must be able to use a telephone or headset equipment and operate a keyboard and other office equipment, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Must be able to spend prolonged periods of each workday on camera in virtual meetings.
  • The ability to perform work at a computer station for 6-8+ hours a day and function in an environment with competing priorities.
  • Must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs.
  • May experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.
  • To help you succeed in your role and ensure member information stays protected, we require that you maintain a secure and stable work environment, i.e., safeguard client information, cameras on during work meetings, and provide a current updated photo. This is a core value of our culture and an essential job function for each of us.

$203000.00 To $268500.00 / year

  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

jobs.description:
OCTO Job

Vous faites partie de celles et ceux qui pensent que même avec plusieurs années d’expérience, on continue à apprendre ? Alors nous sommes sur la même longueur d'onde ! Et si on en parlait ?

Au sein de l’Atelier Software Engineer, on retrouve des communautés de pratique organisées par tribus. L’idée, c’est de se retrouver et de partager des expertises communes, de développer ses compétences en équipes à taille humaine. Vous aurez donc pour missions de faire du conseil, du delivery et de la R&D.

Être Consultant Confirmé chez OCTO, c’est :

1- Faire du conseil autant que du delivery : participez au développement agile d’applications dans le respect des bonnes pratiques Crafts avec une touche Gen AI: check ! Et bien sûr, qui dit conseil, dit convictions : proposer la solution la plus adaptée, c’est aussi savoir et oser challenger nos clients (et c’est dans notre ADN !) ;

2- Participer activement à la R&D “Software Engineer” : au programme, veille technologique & bonnes pratiques. Quelques sujets “chauds” du moment ? Gen AI, Crafts, Archi, Numérique Responsable;

3- Former & mentorer : le partage de connaissances et la montée en compétences des collaborateurs vous importent ? Nous sommes convaincus et prônons haut et fort la valeur de transmission. Mentoring et gestion de votre carrière seront donc à l’honneur. Et oui, chez OCTO le savoir n’est pas chasse gardée.

OCTO Wanted

1- Un socle de savoir-faire techniques: Crafts (TDD, DDD, pair programming, revue de code…), Gen AI

Vous maîtrisez un ou plusieurs langages parmi Java, Python, React, Angular ou Vue ou bien Flutter. Vous faîtes preuve de curiosité et exploré leur potentiel dans des usages Gen AI. Au-delà des technologies, c’est votre envie d’apprendre et de progresser qui fait la différence.

Vous avez la volonté d’en savoir plus sur les sujets du Numérique Responsable, de l’Eco-conception, de l’Accessibilité…

2- Un panel de savoir-être : un esprit franc-tireur capable de (se) questionner et de challenger les idées, une forte appétence pour le travail en équipe et la réussite collective.

OCTO Rewards

Et parce que nous savons qu’un job n’est pas “juste” un job, on vous partage aussi quelques petits + qui font notre différence :

  • 7 participations, 7 certifications et surtout 6 podiums au palmarès « Great Place To Work » : le bien-être et la progression des Octos sont vraiment au cœur de nos préoccupations ;

  • “There is always a better way” : nous encourageons et soutenons l’innovation par la R&D. Au-delà d’une direction scientifique dédiée, nous valorisons le temps hors mission pour partager ses connaissances : blog OCTO, talks, meet-up, livre blanc, BBL… en bref de l’open source alimenté par tous les Octos !

  • Parce que ce ne sont pas que des mots, nous marquons au quotidien notre engagement en matière de numérique responsable : nous formons les Octos et nos clients à la Fresque du Climat / 2 Tonnes et œuvrons pour la sobriété numérique en interne et auprès de nos clients. Depuis 2021, nous sommes labellisés B Corp, et nous sommes fiers de renouveler cette certification toujours plus exigeante en 2025 ;

  • Le management est un point central de notre culture. Les Octos managers sont tous formés via un socle de formations obligatoires pour vous accompagner dans votre développement (carrière, compétences, etc.) ;

  • Parce qu’on n’a jamais fini d’apprendre, vous pourrez tirer parti de notre large offre de formations (softskills, et hardskills), avec un accompagnement personnalisé et 5 jours de formation en moyenne par an, pour affûter vos compétences et vous certifier et, pourquoi pas, devenir vous-même formateur…

  • … sans oublier qu’OCTO est un bain apprenant : chaque jour, les Octos ont la possibilité d’apprendre ensemble, au-delà des formations : BBL, conférences, OCTO Fest, blog OCTO, livres blancs & ref cards, ou tout simplement lors d’échanges informels à la machine à café : c’est aussi ça l’expérience d’apprentissage “à la OCTO” ;

  • Le sujet de la parentalité compte aussi beaucoup à nos yeux. C’est pourquoi nous avons mis à disposition des places en crèche, ainsi que d’une permanence parentalité pour les parents et futurs parents ;

  • Depuis 2022, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de l’Autre Cercle concernant l’inclusion des personnes LGBTQIA+ en entreprise (renouvelée en 2025), et depuis 2023 de la Charte de la Diversité et de l'Accord Handicap. En parallèle, tous les Octos participent à la Fresque de la Diversité dans le cadre de leur parcours de formation (obligatoire). Car nous avons à cœur de proposer un environnement toujours plus inclusif, pour toutes et tous.

Sans oublier les fondamentaux :

  • Matériel au choix : ordinateur (PC ou Mac) et téléphone (Fairphone ou iPhone) ;

  • Télétravail ;

  • Possibilité d’augmentation chaque année conditionnée par l’évaluation annuelle ;

  • Et bien sûr : carte Swile, RTT, primes diverses (participation, vacances, cooptation, bonus basés sur les performances collectives).

OCTO priority

Collaborer avec des personnes talentueuses issues de différents horizons. Aussi, ce que nous cherchons avant tout, ce sont des personnalités qui enrichiront OCTO.

En respectant l'égalité des chances, les candidatures sont examinées sans aucun préjugé quant à l'âge, l'ethnie, l'identité de genre, l’expression de genre, le handicap, la nationalité, la religion ou l'orientation sexuelle.

Premier cabinet d’architectes IT fondé en 1998, pionnier du delivery agile et véritable concentrateur de talents. Nous incarnons les nouvelles façons de faire du conseil et du Delivery. Digital Doers & Thinkers est notre marque de fabrique.

Nous privilégions aujourd'hui notre positionnement Agile & DeepTech et sommes engagés quant à notre responsabilité sociale et environnementale.

jobs.description:
UX Design Lead

Location:Remote/Hybrid/In-Office Options

About the Role
TechnoMile is seeking a Lead UX/UI Designer to lead the design and development of advanced user experiences for our SaaS platform tailored to the Government Contracting (GovCon) industry. This role combines strategic UX leadership with hands-on design, with a strong focus on agentic AI experiences where users collaborate with autonomous systems.

You will define how users interact with AI agents, ensuring clarity, control, and confidence while navigating complex workflows and data-rich environments.

What You’ll Do

Agentic Experience (AX) Design

  • Define and lead how users interact with autonomous AI agents
  • Design human-in-the-loop systems that provide visibility into AI reasoning and decision-making
  • Create interfaces for monitoring long-running agent tasks, including status tracking, alerts, and intervention points
  • Establish clear hand-offs between users and AI systems to maintain trust and control

AI Workflow & Platform Design

  • Design seamless AI-driven workflows across React-based applications, Salesforce, and Microsoft Power Platform (including Teams)
  • Create unified experiences across multiple enterprise ecosystems

Complex Data & Content Systems

  • Architect dashboards and workflows for content-heavy, data-rich environments
  • Design systems that enable AI agents to aggregate, connect, and contextualize disparate data (e.g., linking subcontract records to prime contracts)
  • Translate complex analytics into clear, actionable insights

Advanced AI Interaction Design

  • Move beyond chat interfaces to design canvas/workbench-style experiences
  • Enable real-time collaboration between users and AI agents for document editing, data analysis, and multi-step workflows

Design Systems & Consistency

  • Extend and maintain our design system (based on UntitledUI)
  • Define standardized UI components for:
    • AI status indicators
    • Confidence levels and explainability
    • Approval, undo, and intervention actions

Prototyping & Validation

  • Develop high-fidelity prototypes in tools such as Figma or Bolt to simulate AI-driven interactions
  • Conduct usability testing focused on user trust, clarity, and control over AI systems
  • Iterate based on user feedback and behavioral insights

Strategic & Collaborative Design

  • Define and drive UX vision aligned with business and product strategy
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technically feasible solutions
  • Translate complex requirements into intuitive user experiences
  • Present design concepts and strategies to stakeholders, leadership, and clients

Research & Optimization

  • Conduct user research, persona development, and journey mapping
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform design decisions
  • Continuously refine UX processes, tools, and workflows to improve efficiency and outcomes

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design for SaaS, enterprise, or workflow-heavy products
  • Proven experience designing AI/agentic user experiences beyond simple chat interfaces
  • Asynchronous task monitoring
  • AI transparency and explainability
  • Multi-step automation workflows
  • Strong experience designing for complex data visualization and content-heavy systems
  • Experience working across React, Salesforce, and Microsoft ecosystems (Teams/Power Automate)
  • Proficiency in prototyping tools such as Figma, Bolt, or similar
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Skills

  • Front-end fluency and understanding of how React components integrate with AI APIs, including streaming UI states
  • Experience in B2B enterprise environments, particularly GovCon or regulated industries
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering concepts and LLM/agent capabilities and constraints
  • Experience working with AI/ML or data science teams to translate insights into user-facing features

Who We Are:

TechnoMile provides AI-enabled cloud solutions that empower GovCon, aerospace and defense, and other government-focused companies to modernize operations. Our SaaS products help clients:

  • Optimize business development and sales processes.
  • Streamline and de-risk contract management.
  • Unlock the value of public and private data for a competitive advantage.

Today, more than 200 companies rely on TechnoMile, including over half of the top 10 federal defense contractors and the top 10 IT government contractors.

Our Culture

  • Hungry, Humble, and Smart.We foster continuous learning and career growth, offering tuition reimbursement and ongoing development opportunities.
  • Innovative.We embrace challenges and develop solutions others cannot.
  • Flexible.Remote, hybrid, and in-office options support your best work.
  • Global.With teams across the U.S. and India, we collaborate worldwide with one mission.

jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

  • All CVs should be submitted in English.

  • This position is open to candidates based in countries where World Vision International is legally registered to operate.

This role provides technical leadership in designing, implementing, and continuously improving enterprise disaster recovery capabilities across WVI’s global technology environment. The IT Disaster Recovery Specialist ensures that critical systems, cloud platforms, and applications are resilient and recoverable, aligned to defined RTO and RPO targets. The role drives adoption of DR frameworks, testing programmes, and recovery practices to minimize business disruption and strengthen organisational resilience.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field • ITIL Foundation (minimum); ITIL Intermediate or ITIL 4 Managing Professional is an advantage

  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) or disaster recovery / business continuity (e.g., DRII, CBCI) are desirable

  • 5+ years’ experience in IT Disaster Recovery, Infrastructure Operations, or Business Continuity roles

  • Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise disaster recovery strategies across cloud (Azure/AWS), hybrid, and on-prem environments

  • Hands-on experience with DR technologies (e.g., Azure Site Recovery, AWS DR patterns, backup/replication tools)

  • Experience defining and operationalizing RTO / RPO for critical services

  • Experience leading DR testing (failover, tabletop, live recovery drills) and recovery execution

  • Exposure to hybrid environments (cloud + on-prem infrastructure)

  • Experience integrating DR with ITSM processes (Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem Management).

This position is eligible for Remote or Hybrid-Work based dependent on the country of hire. It involves continuous collaboration with global teams across various time zones. The position requires ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally if needed.

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong understanding of disaster recovery frameworks and standards (e.g., ITIL, ISO 22301, NIST)

  • Experience designing DR architectures including failover, geo-redundancy, and backup strategies

  • Knowledge of infrastructure resilience across compute, storage, network, and identity layers

  • Experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) for repeatable recovery environments

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity incident response and ransomware recovery integration

  • Experience with dashboards, reporting, and DR readiness tracking

Core Competencies:

  • Strong analytical thinking with ability to assess recovery risk and design mitigation strategies

  • Structured, process-driven mindset with focus on governance, documentation, and audit readiness

  • Strong collaboration across infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams

  • Ability to lead calmly and decisively during incident recovery scenarios

  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on resilience, readiness, and operational maturity

  • Customer-focused approach, ensuring minimal business disruption and reliable service recovery

CONTINUATION OF MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

DR Strategy, Framework & Governance

  • Define and maintain enterprise DR policies, standards, and governance framework

  • Establish and refine RTO/RPO targets aligned to business criticality

  • Ensure DR documentation is audit-ready and integrated with ITSM processes

  • Align DR practices with business continuity strategy
